items.title_en: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐激光雷达距离图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced.
items.abstract_zh: 在密集人群和杂乱场所中运行的自主移动机器人需要 360° 感知，以对周围危险做出反应。全景 LiDAR 虽提供全方位覆盖，但在稀疏奖励下，在强化学习（RL）中学习表征的样本效率低，且现有 3D 预训练点云编码器对大规模并行 RL 仿真而言内存开销过大。我们提出 RangeNav，一种完全在合成数据上预训练的紧凑型（183k 参数）LiDAR 距离图像编码器。RangeNav 使用各向异性卷积和循环填充来处理距离图像的极端长宽比和方位角接缝。我们使用一种导航对齐目标预训练该网络，该目标结合距离重建、语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）预测，然后将其冻结用于策略学习。在仿真中，与仅重建基线相比，加入语义和 BEV 监督在程序化生成的训练环境和分布外真实测试环境中分别平均将成功率提高 32.03 和 23.73 个百分点（pp）。在 Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上的零样本真实世界部署表明，其可在密集人群、低光环境和施工区域中稳健导航，而这些场景中有限视场深度策略难以应对。代码和模型将开源。
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027; under review

items.title_en: Real-Time Event-Based LED Tracking and Pose Estimation with PWM-Encoded Markers
items.title_zh: 基于PWM编码标记的实时事件相机LED跟踪与位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are neuromorphic vision sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, supporting state estimation under rapid motion, motion blur, and high dynamic range (HDR) illumination. This also enables capture of high-frequency blinking patterns from light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Based on this, we propose a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) relative pose estimation using pulse-width modulation (PWM)-encoded LED markers. Multiple LEDs share a common blinking frequency and encode identities through distinct PWM duty cycles, reducing frequency-resource requirements and computational cost. Our dual-rate asynchronous tracking framework combines low-rate LED detection with high-rate raw-event updates, maintaining robust LED identity association and accurate pixel-level tracking under rapid motion. LED identities and positions establish reliable 2D-3D correspondences for real-time metric 6-DoF relative pose estimation. Extensive evaluations on a self-collected dataset demonstrate robustness under large motion flow and transient image-plane LED overlap. Furthermore, we develop a coordinated robotic platform comprising a quadrotor and a Mecanum-wheeled mobile robot, demonstrating the proposed framework's potential for closed-loop drone guidance through hovering and target-following experiments under time-varying HDR illumination, with onboard deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The dataset and implementation will be released to facilitate further research.
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机像素以微秒级异步响应亮度变化，可在快速运动、运动模糊和HDR照明下工作，并能捕获LED高频闪烁。本文提出基于PWM编码LED标记的实时事件框架，实现LED跟踪与6-DoF相对位姿估计。多个LED共享闪烁频率、以不同占空比编码身份，降低频率资源与计算成本；双速率异步跟踪结合低速率检测与高速率事件更新，在快速运动下保持身份关联和像素级跟踪，并建立2D-3D对应实现实时度量位姿估计。自采数据与四旋翼-麦克纳姆轮平台实验验证了鲁棒性及机载闭环引导潜力。
items.highlight_zh: 用PWM占空比编码LED身份，实现事件相机实时6-DoF位姿估计
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：在高速运动、运动模糊和强/弱光并存的HDR场景中，传统相机难以稳定跟踪标记并估计无人机等平台的相对位姿。方法：利用事件相机对亮度变化微秒级响应的特性，设计PWM编码LED标记——多个LED共用同一闪烁频率，仅用不同占空比区分身份，减少频段占用和识别计算；再用双速率异步框架，低速检测LED、高速用原始事件更新位置，维持身份关联与像素级跟踪，并由LED的2D观测和已知3D位置求解实时6-DoF度量位姿。结果：自采数据表明，在大运动流和LED在像面短暂重叠时仍能稳定工作；在四旋翼与麦克纳姆轮机器人组成的平台上，于时变HDR照明下完成悬停和目标跟随，并部署在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上。意义：为事件相机提供低资源、可机载的实时位姿估计方案，展示闭环无人机引导潜力。
items.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

items.title_en: Distance Field Driven Reinforcement Learning for Reactive and Robust Collision Avoidance
items.title_zh: 距离场驱动的强化学习用于反应式与鲁棒避障
items.abstract_en: Robust and reactive collision avoidance remains a central challenge for deploying Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies on real robotic manipulators, particularly when transferring behaviours learned in simulation to the physical world. This paper presents an RL framework that integrates the Euclidean Distance Field (EDF) directly into the observation space, providing the agent with continuous geometric cues that support stable and responsive avoidance behaviours. By leveraging the rich spatial information encoded in the EDF, the method enables a streamlined reward formulation that achieves effective obstacle avoidance both with and without Artificial Potential Field guidance. The proposed approach is validated on a 7-DoF redundant manipulator, demonstrating zero-shot transfer from simulation to real hardware. Despite being trained exclusively with randomised static objects, the deployed policy generalizes to previously unseen real environments and exhibits robust online avoidance of dynamic obstacles. These results highlight the potential of EDF-based representations to mitigate the sim-to-real gap and support reliable and real-time collision-aware behaviour in complex and changing environments.
items.abstract_zh: 稳健且反应式的避撞仍然是在真实机械臂上部署强化学习（RL）策略的核心挑战，尤其是在将仿真中学习到的行为迁移到物理世界时。本文提出一种 RL 框架，将欧氏距离场（EDF）直接集成到观测空间中，为智能体提供连续的几何线索，以支持稳定且响应式的避障行为。通过利用 EDF 中编码的丰富空间信息，该方法实现了简化的奖励形式，在有人工势场引导和无人工势场引导的情况下均能有效避障。所提方法在 7 自由度冗余机械臂上得到验证，展示了从仿真到真实硬件的零样本迁移。尽管仅使用随机化静态物体进行训练，部署的策略仍能泛化到先前未见过的真实环境，并表现出对动态障碍物的稳健在线避障能力。这些结果凸显了基于 EDF 的表征在缓解 sim-to-real 差距方面的潜力，并支持在复杂且变化环境中实现可靠、实时的碰撞感知行为。
items.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

items.title_en: Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation
items.title_zh: 双变分自编码器用于低成本机器人导航中的高效仿真到现实迁移
items.abstract_en: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 低成本机器人的基于视觉自主导航仍然是一项基本挑战，主要由于仿真训练环境与真实世界运行条件之间存在显著差距。从仿真直接迁移策略通常无效，而仅在真实数据上训练则不切实际。我们提出一种混合迁移学习框架，通过结合域随机化与特征级域适应，有效弥合 sim-to-real 差距。我们的方法采用具有共享解码器的双卷积变分自编码器架构，在 45225 张仿真图像的大型集合和仅 4556 个真实世界样本的最小集合上训练。该架构学习一个紧凑的公共潜在表示空间，使两个域的分布对齐。适应过程还通过两种互补的数据增强技术进一步增强，这些技术旨在扩展有限的真实世界数据。实验评估表明，我们的方法在真实世界室内导航的图像分类任务上达到近 91% 的平均成功率，显著优于仅仿真训练和仅真实世界训练。我们通过直接的真实世界部署验证了这些发现，其中所提策略在反应式探索任务中成功引导低成本机器人。此外，我们通过严格的计算估计验证了模型的效率，确认其适用于资源受限的嵌入式平台，如 Raspberry Pi 4 和 NVIDIA Jetson Nano。这项工作为低成本机器人系统开发有效且高效的导航策略提供了一种实用解决方案。
items.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures. Published in Image and Vision Computing under a CC BY 4.0 license

items.title_en: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: VLA-Stem：一种通过强化学习为视觉-语言-动作模型提供的轻量级安全机制
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将高层推理与低层动作执行相结合，实现端到端机器人控制。然而，大多数 VLA 模型针对无约束环境中的静态操作，忽视了空间约束和动态障碍物。在避障数据上微调 VLA 是一种直接解决方案，但收集此类数据成本高昂，尤其是动态场景，并且可能降低其原始任务能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出 VLA-Stem，一种基于强化学习的轻量级 VLA 系统安全机制。VLA-Stem 在不微调底层 VLA 策略的情况下，将其动作块转换为运动参考，并使用轨迹级引导保留其空间意图，同时允许灵活的运动和时间调整。以这些参考、机器人本体感觉和局部障碍物信息为条件，Stem 策略在推理时自适应修改执行，在保留原始任务意图的同时，能够对空间约束和动态障碍物做出响应式适应。为实现稳健且样本高效的训练，我们结合教师-学生蒸馏与课程学习。我们在参考跟随、静态空间约束和动态避障上评估 VLA-Stem。在六个受约束仿真设置中，VLA-Stem 实现了 52.8% 的平均无碰撞任务成功率，而最强的安全基线为 23.7%，同时在无障碍设置中保持基础策略性能；真实世界实验进一步表明，在静态和动态障碍物下碰撞持续减少。这些结果表明，VLA-Stem 将高层 VLA 任务意图与对即时物理风险的快速、类反射响应相结合，为稳健机器人执行提供了一种受脑干启发的机制。
items.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures

items.title_en: SwarmNxt: Open-source Software-Hardware Platform for Fast and Agile Aerial Swarms
items.title_zh: SwarmNxt：面向快速敏捷空中集群的开源软硬件平台
items.abstract_en: Aerial robot swarms have the potential to transform time-critical safety, security, and search-and-rescue operations. By coordinating multiple robots, they can rapidly survey disaster sites, map collapsed or GPS-denied environments, and search cluttered areas faster than a single robot, reducing response times and minimizing risks to first responders. Realizing this potential, however, requires robust autonomous swarm navigation, which remains an active research challenge. Progress is further constrained by existing platforms, as commercial drones are often closed-source or lack the onboard computational resources needed for agile, vision-based collective flight. Moreover, developing, deploying, and maintaining software across multiple aerial robots requires significant engineering effort. To address these challenges, we present SwarmNxt, an open-source software platform built on the open-source OmniNxt drone hardware. SwarmNxt provides an end-to-end toolkit, including detailed hardware assembly instructions with a video tutorial, automation tools for parallel software deployment and swarm-wide updates, and a ROS 2-based framework for autonomous navigation. The platform integrates state-of-the-art control, planning, and depth estimation into a single ROS 2 multi-agent system, providing an open research infrastructure for physical swarm experimentation. We validate SwarmNxt through two real-world experiments: a six-drone swarm performing decentralized planning with high-speed inter-drone collision avoidance, and a four-drone swarm executing collective flight with onboard depth estimation in an obstacle-filled environment. Both experiments were run indoors with global position from external motion capture; perception, planning, and control run onboard.
items.abstract_zh: 空中机器人集群有潜力改变时间关键的安全、安保和搜救行动。通过协调多个机器人，它们可以比单个机器人更快地勘察灾害现场、绘制倒塌或 GPS 拒止环境地图并搜索杂乱区域，从而缩短响应时间并最大限度降低第一响应人员的风险。然而，实现这一潜力需要稳健的自主集群导航，这仍是一个活跃的研究挑战。现有平台进一步限制了进展，因为商用无人机通常闭源或缺乏敏捷、基于视觉的集体飞行所需的机载计算资源。此外，在多架空中机器人上开发、部署和维护软件需要大量工程投入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SwarmNxt，一个构建在开源 OmniNxt 无人机硬件上的开源软件平台。SwarmNxt 提供端到端工具包，包括带有视频教程的详细硬件组装说明、用于并行软件部署和集群范围更新的自动化工具，以及基于 ROS 2 的自主导航框架。该平台将最先进的控制、规划和深度估计集成到单个 ROS 2 多智能体系统中，为物理集群实验提供开放研究基础设施。我们通过两个真实世界实验验证 SwarmNxt：一个六无人机集群执行去中心化规划并进行高速机间避碰，以及一个四无人机集群在充满障碍的环境中执行带有板载深度估计的集体飞行。两个实验均在室内运行，全局位置来自外部动作捕捉；感知、规划和控制均在机载运行。

items.title_en: Learning Robot Metareasoning: Adaptive Computation Budgets for Real-Time Control
items.title_zh: 学习机器人元推理：面向实时控制的自适应计算预算
items.abstract_en: Planning while moving faces an historical trade-off between deliberation and reactivity. A planner running concurrently with execution needs time to compute, so the robot must commit to an open-loop action chunk for that duration: a longer commitment buys a better plan at the cost of feedback frequency. Existing controllers fix this action commitment, and consequently the computation budget, before deployment. However, the optimal computation time is highly state-dependent (due to factors such as unmodeled dynamics, safety constraints, and marginal optimisation gains), i.e. dynamic, therefore offline static tuning risks leaving systems blind during critical maneuvers or unable to find global effective solutions. We cast the identification of the optimal computation budget as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) in which a single decision defines both the robot action commitments and the time allocated to the solver. To solve this, we train a reinforcement-learning policy conditioned on the current state, the executing plan, and inexpensive planner statistics. Across ground-robot navigation, agile quadrotor flight, and contact-rich manipulation, the learned policy changes its budget with the demands of the scenario, discovering efficient reasoning patterns that outperform fixed-budget baselines. https://lorenzomagnino.github.io/learning-robot-metareasoning-review/
items.abstract_zh: 边移动边规划面临着推理与反应性之间的历史性权衡。与执行并发运行的规划器需要时间进行计算，因此机器人必须在这段时间内承诺一个开环动作块：更长的承诺以反馈频率为代价换取更好的规划。现有控制器在部署前固定这种动作承诺，从而固定计算预算。然而，最优计算时间高度依赖于状态（由于未建模动力学、安全约束和边际优化增益等因素），即动态变化，因此离线静态调参存在风险：系统可能在关键机动期间失明，或无法找到全局有效解。我们将最优计算预算的辨识表述为一个半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），其中单个决策同时定义机器人动作承诺和分配给求解器的时间。为解决此问题，我们训练一个强化学习策略，其条件为当前状态、正在执行的规划以及廉价的规划器统计量。在地面机器人导航、敏捷四旋翼飞行和接触丰富操作中，学习到的策略根据场景需求改变其预算，发现优于固定预算基线的有效推理模式。https://lorenzomagnino.github.io/learning-robot-metareasoning-review/

items.title_en: A hybrid pipeline for dynamic ontology-based semantic mapping
items.title_zh: 一种用于基于动态本体的语义映射的混合流水线
items.abstract_en: Semantic mapping plays a crucial role in the ability of a robot to interact with objects, operate and navigate a complex environment. The most common pipeline for semantic mapping consists of geometric mapping and localization (SLAM), perception, semantic fusion and semantic representation. However, more recent works also integrate a form of prior knowledge in their application, most notably knowledge graphs or semantic scene graphs, to improve contextual understanding of the environment. In this paper, we present a hybrid pipeline for semantic mapping. Our system incorporates an external calibrated camera using homography projection for geometric mapping and localization, combined with object detection, persistent object tracking and ontology driven semantic updates to build a dynamic semantic world model. Linear regression models are also used for correction of the estimated values of real world coordinates. The system continuously updates object instances, spatial properties and semantic relations based on real time sensory data. Ontologies are selected as form of knowledge representation due to their hierarchical structure, semantic expressiveness and support for dynamic world modelling.
items.abstract_zh: 语义建图在机器人交互物体、操作和导航复杂环境的能力中起着关键作用。最常见的语义建图流水线由几何建图与定位（SLAM）、感知、语义融合和语义表示组成。然而，更近期的工作还在应用中集成了某种先验知识，最显著的是知识图谱或语义场景图，以改善对环境的上下文理解。本文提出一种用于语义建图的混合流水线。我们的系统使用经过外部标定的相机，通过单应性投影进行几何建图与定位，并结合目标检测、持久目标跟踪和本体驱动的语义更新，构建动态语义世界模型。线性回归模型还用于校正真实世界坐标的估计值。系统基于实时传感器数据持续更新对象实例、空间属性和语义关系。选择本体作为知识表示形式，是因为其层次结构、语义表达力以及对动态世界建模的支持。

items.title_en: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
items.title_zh: 用于安全感知潜在空间运动规划的控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $α$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $α\in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在空间路径规划（LSPP）将机器人机械臂的构型空间压缩为变分自编码器学习到的紧凑可微流形，从而无需显式逆运动学即可实现快速的基于梯度的规划。现有LSPP框架使用二值碰撞分类器来强制执行避障，其在障碍物边界附近饱和的梯度和缺乏时间结构导致优化器停滞，且不提供前向不变性保证。我们用直接在潜在空间中学习的神经控制屏障函数（CBF）替换该分类器。该屏障函数通过三项目标训练，该目标将安全和不安全的符号约束与在障碍物盲标称规划器转移上评估的离散时间递减条件相结合，并在规划时通过闭式一阶修正强制执行，该修正将每个目标导向的潜在步长投影回CBF约束。在7自由度Franka Panda机械臂上，CBF规划器在固定障碍物任务上达到75.6%的成功率，比35个调优分类器配置中的最佳结果高12.0个百分点，在多位置任务上达到83.8%。对衰减率$α$的扫描刻画了安全-性能权衡，最佳工作点在$α\in [0.10, 0.20]$。在完全通用的随机障碍物设置中，成功率降至33.0%，我们将其归因于障碍物盲训练转移与修正规划器访问状态之间的协变量偏移。
items.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures

items.title_en: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
items.title_zh: Omni-IGN：面向无人机全向视觉的机载图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中到达由目标图像指定的位置。对无人机而言，该任务需要在有限的机载计算资源下完成探索、目标导向导航和避障。现有的空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视角观测构建，需要额外旋转和探索以搜索视场外的目标相关线索。本文提出 Omni-IGN，一个完全机载的 ImageNav 系统，集成了四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习（RL）策略和碰撞感知安全层。该策略自适应地融合多视角中的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导。四鱼眼 RGB 图像同时支持 ImageNav 和避障，无需专用深度传感器。在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中取得最佳性能。此外，IsaacSim 中的飞行测试验证了将学习型深度估计与动作安全层结合用于避障的有效性。最后，真实世界实验展示了无需任何微调或外部定位的零样本仿真到现实迁移。代码和模型检查点将在接收后发布。

items.title_en: TransNav: Transformer-Based End-to-End Navigation Method for Static and Dynamic Quadrotor Obstacle Avoidance
items.title_zh: TransNav：基于 Transformer 的静态与动态四旋翼避障端到端导航方法
items.abstract_en: Obstacle avoidance for autonomous quadrotors in cluttered environments remains challenging, especially when both dense static obstacles and moving obstacles are present. Existing methods are often tailored to either static or dynamic settings, which always limit their adaptability across diverse environments. This paper presents TransNav, a transformer-based end-to-end navigation method for quadrotor obstacle avoidance in both static and dynamic environments. TransNav employs a patch-based point-cloud encoding scheme that combines local feature extraction with global contextual modeling, enabling compact yet informative environment representation. The method integrates perception and navigation in a single architecture and directly predicts a finite-horizon action sequence, from which the first action is executed. Moreover, we develop an unsupervised learning strategy by incorporating a lightweight point-mass dynamics model, which directly optimizes trajectory-level costs over the predicted sequence through numerical gradient propagation. Thus, the policy can be efficiently trained without expert demonstrations. Simulation and real-world experiments show that the proposed method achieves strong performance in dense static environments and competitive obstacle-avoidance capability in dynamic scenarios, while maintaining low inference cost for onboard deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主四旋翼在杂乱环境中的避障仍具挑战，尤其是当密集静态障碍物和移动障碍物同时存在时。现有方法往往针对静态或动态环境之一而设计，这常常限制了它们在不同环境间的适应性。本文提出 TransNav，一种基于 Transformer 的端到端导航方法，用于四旋翼在静态和动态环境中的避障。TransNav 采用基于块（patch）的点云编码方案，将局部特征提取与全局上下文建模相结合，实现紧凑而信息丰富的环境表示。该方法在单一架构中集成感知与导航，并直接预测有限时域的动作序列，执行其中的第一个动作。此外，我们通过引入轻量级质点动力学模型开发了一种无监督学习策略，该策略通过数值梯度传播直接针对预测序列上的轨迹级代价进行优化。因此，策略无需专家示范即可高效训练。仿真与真实世界实验表明，所提方法在密集静态环境中取得强劲性能，在动态场景中具有竞争力的避障能力，同时保持较低的推理开销以支持机载部署。
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

items.title_en: FIRE-LIVWO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry via Failure-Immune mmWave Radar Enhancement
items.title_zh: FIRE-LIVWO：故障免疫毫米波雷达增强的鲁棒激光雷达-惯性-视觉-轮式里程计
items.abstract_en: Achieving robust SLAM in large-scale underground coal mines with complex structures and severe degeneracies remains highly challenging. Dense smoke and dust cause substantial loss of visual information and degrade LiDAR point-cloud features, while long, self-similar corridors induce geometric degeneration, leading to pronounced odometry drift. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-LIVWO: Failure-Immune mmWave Radar-Enhanced LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry, a tightly coupled multi-modal odometry framework based on an iterated error-state Kalman filter (IESKF). The framework fuses 4D mmWave radar, LiDAR, and visual features within a unified VoxelMap and jointly constructs LiDAR-radar point-to-plane residuals and sparse visual photometric residuals. In smoke-filled environments, we exploit the strong penetration of 4D mmWave radar and introduce pointwise Doppler velocity constraints to preserve state observability. In geometrically degenerate corridors, we tightly couple wheel odometry using non-holonomic constraints (NHC) and online lever-arm compensation to reduce drift. Our central contribution is a degeneration detection and adaptive fusion model switching strategy grounded in geometric and visual observability analysis, which quantifies observability online and dynamically adjusts modality weights. Real-world experiments in underground coal mines demonstrate that FIRE-LIVWO accurately identifies failure boundaries, enabling reliable modality switching under extreme conditions. Compared with baselines, it achieves superior accuracy and robustness (average localization error of 5.677m). We open source our code on Github to benefit the robotics community.
items.abstract_zh: 在结构复杂且退化严重的的大型地下煤矿中实现鲁棒SLAM仍然极具挑战。浓烟和粉尘导致视觉信息大量丢失并降低激光雷达点云特征质量，而长且自相似的巷道引发几何退化，导致明显的里程计漂移。为解决这些问题，我们提出FIRE-LIVWO：抗失效毫米波雷达增强的激光雷达-惯性-视觉-轮式里程计，一种基于迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波（IESKF）的紧耦合多模态里程计框架。该框架在统一的VoxelMap中融合4D毫米波雷达、激光雷达和视觉特征，并联合构建激光雷达-雷达点到面残差和稀疏视觉光度残差。在烟雾弥漫环境中，我们利用4D毫米波雷达的强穿透性，并引入逐点多普勒速度约束以保持状态可观测性。在几何退化巷道中，我们使用非完整约束（NHC）和在线杆臂补偿来紧耦合轮式里程计，以减少漂移。我们的核心贡献是一种基于几何和视觉可观测性分析的退化检测与自适应融合模型切换策略，其在线量化可观测性并动态调整模态权重。在地下煤矿的真实世界实验表明，FIRE-LIVWO能够准确识别失效边界，从而在极端条件下实现可靠的模态切换。与基线相比，它实现了更高的精度和鲁棒性（平均定位误差为5.677m）。我们在Github上开源代码，以惠及机器人社区。
items.comment: Accepted by IROS 2026.The project website is "https://kj-falloutlast.github.io/FIRE-LIVWO"

items.title_en: Demo: Closed-Loop Sionna-Isaac Sim Co-Simulation Framework for Wireless-Aware Robot Navigation over ROS 2
items.title_zh: Demo：面向 ROS 2 上无线感知机器人导航的闭环 Sionna-Isaac Sim 联合仿真框架
items.abstract_en: A robot that offloads its control loop to the network carries the receiver with it, so link quality is decided by where it goes. Simulating this requires both a physics engine and a site-specific propagation model at once; to our knowledge no simulator natively unifies both, with existing couplings of the two limited to offline analyses. We demonstrate a real-time co-simulation framework coupling NVIDIA Isaac Sim and NVIDIA Sionna over ROS 2 that closes the perception-action-communication (PAC) loop between them. Sionna ray-traces the base-station-to-robot channel over the exact geometry Isaac Sim simulates on, rather than modeling it stochastically, and feeds channel states back into the control loop in real time. Ray-traced on GPU, the coverage map is refreshed in ~16ms (~60 Hz), fast enough for real-time control. To showcase the framework's utility, we implement a wireless-aware navigation application in an OpenStreetMap(OSM)-derived SUTD campus twin with two Nova Carter robots: the closed-loop planner eliminates communication outage at only +7.4% traversal time over the shortest-path baseline (which spends 7.9 s of its 81.2 s run disconnected).
items.abstract_zh: 将控制回路卸载到网络的机器人会随身携带接收器，因此链路质量由其行进位置决定。对此进行仿真需要同时具备物理引擎和站点特定传播模型；据我们所知，尚无仿真器原生统一二者，现有二者的耦合仅限于离线分析。我们演示了一个通过 ROS 2 耦合 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 和 NVIDIA Sionna 的实时联合仿真框架，该框架在二者之间闭环感知-行动-通信（PAC）回路。Sionna 在 Isaac Sim 所仿真的精确几何上对基站到机器人信道进行射线追踪，而不是对其进行随机建模，并将信道状态实时反馈到控制回路。在 GPU 上进行射线追踪时，覆盖图约每 16 ms（约 60 Hz）刷新一次，快到足以用于实时控制。为展示该框架的实用性，我们在由 OpenStreetMap（OSM）导出的 SUTD 校园数字孪生中，使用两个 Nova Carter 机器人实现了一个无线感知导航应用：闭环规划器消除了通信中断，相比最短路径基线仅增加 7.4% 的通行时间（该基线在 81.2 s 的运行中有 7.9 s 处于断连状态）。
items.comment: 2 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a Demo paper at ACM MobiHoc 2026. Demo video: https://youtu.be/_TE7tGWxK6A

items.title_en: Semantic SLAM in Precision Agriculture using Bayesian Inference
items.title_zh: 精准农业中基于贝叶斯推断的语义 SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework specialized for precision agriculture using autonomous robots. The framework combines probabilistic mapping of objects and their semantic attributes, updated through Bayesian inference, with a graph-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) approach implemented using $g^2o$, a general framework for graph optimization. This integration enables accurate mapping and localization without relying solely on GPS. By leveraging semantic information such as plant type, size, and health, the robot can perform tasks while mapping and localizing itself within a field of crops. The proposed framework was validated through Gazebo simulations and physical experiments on an indoor field with artificial plants using Boston Dynamics' robot dog Spot. A YOLOv8n object detection model was trained to extract object and semantic data from depth camera observations. These simulations and experiments demonstrate that the system can successfully perform real-time mapping of up to at least 400 plants.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向使用自主机器人的精准农业的实时语义世界建模框架。该框架将对象及其语义属性的概率建图（通过贝叶斯推断更新）与基于图的同步定位与建图（SLAM）方法相结合，后者使用图优化通用框架 g^2o 实现。这种集成使得无需仅依赖 GPS 即可实现准确建图和定位。通过利用植物类型、大小和健康等语义信息，机器人可以在作物田中执行任务，同时进行建图和定位。所提框架通过 Gazebo 仿真以及使用 Boston Dynamics 机器狗 Spot 在带人造植物的室内田地上的物理实验进行了验证。训练了一个 YOLOv8n 目标检测模型，以从深度相机观测中提取对象和语义数据。这些仿真和实验表明，该系统能够成功实时建图至少多达 400 株植物。

items.title_en: TravSUITE: Traversability via Self-Supervised, Uncertainty-Aware IRL and Terrain Estimation
items.title_zh: TravSUITE：基于自监督、不确定性感知IRL与地形估计的可通行性
items.abstract_en: Traversability analysis in off-road settings remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robots. Key difficulties include constructing an accurate and expressive local map from multimodal sensor data, and using the map to design traversability rules that yield desirable navigation behavior. Importantly, this system must be resilient to the limited sensing regime brought about by complex environments and high speeds. In this paper, we present TravSUITE, a traversability system suitable for high-speed navigation in off-road environments. TravSUITE consists of two major components: 1) an efficient voxel mapper that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs) to build a rich geometric-semantic local map from streams of on-board sensor data, and 2) a unified neural network that jointly predicts traversability-relevant quantities in bird's eye view (BEV), including geometry, semantics, speed and cost. Our training strategy is entirely annotation-free and self-supervised, leveraging tasks such as map inpainting and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to learn both map representations and traversability. We perform a thorough ablation study and comparison to state-of-the-art approaches, and the results indicate that cost learning and auxiliary inpainting each contribute significantly to planning quality, and their combination is critical for achieving state-of-the-art performance in off-road path planning. We also design a simple risk adaptation mechanism to leverage our method's uncertainty estimates at deploy-time, and demonstrate that a combination of inpainting and risk estimation can result in 80% fewer navigation errors and 5% faster autonomous traversal speeds in real-world hardware experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 越野环境中的可通行性分析仍然是移动机器人的一项基本挑战。关键困难包括从多模态传感器数据构建准确且具有表现力的局部地图，以及利用该地图设计可产生理想导航行为的可通行性规则。重要的是，该系统必须能够适应复杂环境和高速度带来的有限感知条件。本文提出TravSUITE，一种适用于越野环境高速导航的可通行性系统。TravSUITE由两个主要部分组成：1）高效体素建图器，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）从车载传感器数据流构建丰富的几何-语义局部地图；2）统一神经网络，在鸟瞰图（BEV）中联合预测与可通行性相关的量，包括几何、语义、速度和代价。我们的训练策略完全无需标注且为自监督，利用地图修复和逆强化学习（IRL）等任务同时学习地图表示和可通行性。我们进行了全面的消融研究并与最先进方法比较，结果表明代价学习和辅助修复各自对规划质量有显著贡献，二者的结合对于在越野路径规划中达到最先进性能至关重要。我们还设计了一种简单的风险适应机制，以在部署时利用该方法的不确定性估计，并证明在真实硬件实验中，修复与风险估计的结合可使导航错误减少80%，自主通行速度提高5%。

items.title_en: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: AgilePE：基于自博弈强化学习的自主无人机追逃
items.abstract_en: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. For training, we use competitive self-play with Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) and a diversified opponent pool, enabling agents to improve against historical policies while stabilizing optimization and reducing policy oscillation. This process leads to the emergence of sophisticated pursuit and evasion strategies. For real-world deployment, we develop a hardware-aligned simulation pipeline that models actuator-response dynamics, communication latency, and domain randomization. The learned policies transfer zero-shot to real quadrotors without task-specific tuning. Real-world experiments reproduce pursuit-evasion tactics observed in simulation, including rapid dodging and flanking, and demonstrate interactive two-agent zero-shot deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主追逃是无人机（UAV）的一项基本挑战，需要在紧耦合动力学和持续变化的对手行为下快速决策。传统的基于规则或微分博弈的方法往往难以应对高维空中交互和敏捷机动。我们提出 AgilePE，一个通过自博弈强化学习实现无人机自主追逃的完整系统。AgilePE 将敏捷底层控制、竞争性策略优化和仿真到现实部署集成于统一框架中。该策略直接将机载状态观测映射为总推力与机体角速率（CTBR）指令，实现端到端敏捷机动，无需中间轨迹规划器或航点控制器。在训练方面，我们采用带优先虚拟自博弈（PFSP）的竞争性自博弈以及多样化的对手池，使智能体能够针对历史策略持续改进，同时稳定优化并减少策略振荡。这一过程促成了复杂追逃策略的涌现。针对真实世界部署，我们开发了一个硬件对齐的仿真流程，对执行器响应动力学、通信延迟和域随机化进行建模。学习所得策略零样本迁移到真实四旋翼上，无需任务特定调参。真实世界实验复现了仿真中观察到的追逃战术，包括快速闪避和侧翼包抄，并展示了交互式双智能体零样本部署。
items.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Under review

items.title_en: RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向空中机器人在定位不确定性下快速自主视觉探索的统一主动 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
items.abstract_zh: 主动同时定位与建图（SLAM）解决的是通过高效探索规划机器人运动，以在未知环境中构建完整、准确地图并保持高定位精度的问题。这带来了在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环闭合之间的两难。尽管地面机器人已有大量先前工作，但具有高敏捷性和受限传感器配置的空中机器人面临更显著的定位漂移，因而需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划。此外，能够根据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略仍是一个开放问题。本文提出 RAVEN，一个用于四旋翼快速自主视觉探索（Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN）并系统考虑定位不确定性的统一主动 SLAM 框架。该框架首先识别前沿和主动回环闭合候选，并由此生成全局巡游候选。这些候选通过一个分别量化探索效率和定位精度的效用向量进行评估，最终巡游依据取值范围为 [0,1] 的优先级参数进行选择。最后，感知感知导航规划器基于实时提供视觉定位信息的在线 Fisher 信息场，生成使视觉状态估计误差最小化的平滑执行轨迹。基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于当前最先进的主动 SLAM 方法，凸显其在不同优先级下产生一系列性能表现的优势。使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼进行的完全机载现场实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实际适用性。源代码将发布以惠及社区。
items.comment: Conditionally accepted to the IEEE Transactions on Robotics

items.title_en: Safety-Critical Quadrotor Navigation Using Fourth-Order Control Barrier Functions with Full Nonlinear Quadrotor Dynamics
items.title_zh: 使用具有完整非线性四旋翼动力学的四阶控制障碍函数进行安全关键四旋翼导航
items.abstract_en: Safety-critical quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments typically relies on hierarchical architectures in which a high-level safety filter modifies position references that are then tracked by a separate attitude controller. However, this separation can create a mismatch between translational safety objectives and attitude evolution. To address this gap, we propose a safety controller based on fourth-order control barrier functions (CBFs) that explicitly incorporates the full nonlinear quadrotor dynamics, including attitude dynamics and torque-level actuation. Furthermore, we apply the integral high-order CBF technique to resolve the mixed-relative degree issue in the derived constraint formulation. The resulting formulation enforces obstacle-avoidance constraints while optimizing control torques, granting the safety layer direct authority over attitude behavior and eliminating the hierarchical disconnect inherent in reference-tracking safety filters. We validate the approaches in both high-fidelity simulation and real-world flight experiments, demonstrating reliable constraint satisfaction and successful obstacle avoidance. These results suggest that torque-level high-order CBFs provide a practical pathway to provably safer quadrotor navigation under full rigid-body dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的安全关键四旋翼导航通常依赖分层架构，其中高层安全滤波器修改位置参考，再由单独的姿态控制器跟踪。然而，这种分离会造成平移安全目标与姿态演化之间的不匹配。为解决这一差距，我们提出一种基于四阶控制障碍函数（CBF）的安全控制器，显式纳入完整的非线性四旋翼动力学，包括姿态动力学和力矩级驱动。此外，我们应用积分高阶 CBF 技术来解决推导出的约束公式中的混合相对度问题。所得公式在优化控制力矩的同时强制执行避障约束，使安全层对姿态行为具有直接控制权，并消除参考跟踪安全滤波器固有的分层脱节。我们在高保真仿真和真实飞行实验中验证了这些方法，展示了可靠的约束满足和成功的避障。这些结果表明，力矩级高阶 CBF 为在完整刚体动力学下实现可证明更安全的四旋翼导航提供了一条实用途径。

items.title_en: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
items.title_zh: trACT：时间揭示式机载相机陷阱
items.abstract_en: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 使用无人机的有效远程监控与监视经常受到严重环境与热杂波、动态植被、目标伪装和系统延迟的阻碍。受猛禽悬停并稳定视觉以分离细微地面运动的捕猎策略启发，我们提出 trACT（temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap），一个面向消费级无人机自主运行的轻量级实时空中机器人框架。该系统集成了时间最大池化（Temporal Max Pooling, TMP）——一种低层信号处理方法，将滚动积分窗口内不可察觉的运动转换为稳健的值与时间编码——以及自监督运动异常检测，以将目标运动与阵风和无人机漂移引起的背景环境运动分离。为克服机械和处理延迟，trACT 将运动预测与自动云台稳定的光学变焦验证以及公平的多目标验证平衡相结合。在密集森林野生动物栖息地和监视场景中进行的大量真实世界野外实验表明，trACT 在具有挑战性的操作条件下成功弥合了广域空中监测与精确自主目标验证之间的差距。

items.title_en: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
items.title_zh: 用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的集成开源栈
items.abstract_en: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主性需要在有限传感和计算资源下集成感知、定位、规划和平台特定控制。我们提出一个开源ROS 2栈，用于跟随方向箭头、到达终端锥桶并自主返回起点。它将YOLOv8n检测以及几何方向、距离和方位估计与RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、运动学感知规划、行为树任务管理和STM32执行器连接起来。标准接口将可复用自主性与硬件层分离；比例路径跟随插件支持低速漫游车运动。公共资源包括软件、配置、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张留出图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下达到0.720的mAP@0.5，并在共享评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线。报告的在Jetson Orin NX上的感知延迟为25 ms。三个任务（一个室内和两个室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回，无需操作员运动命令且未报告碰撞。现场结果记录了集成失败和纠正选择；仍需要重复的仪器化试验来量化物理导航误差和可靠性。

items.title_en: Learning Air-Ground Motion Control with Temporal Mode Switching and Cross-Terrain Tracking
items.title_zh: 学习具有时间模式切换与跨地形跟踪的空中-地面运动控制
items.abstract_en: Passive-wheeled terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles (TABVs) combine aerial mobility with energy-efficient ground locomotion. However, reliable air-ground mode switching under limited onboard perception and robust ground trajectory tracking across diverse terrains remain challenging when targeting real-world applications. In this work, we propose a learning-based air-ground motion control framework for passive-wheeled TABVs: 1) a learned mode selector for autonomous air-ground motion mode switching. The selector uses historical single-point time-of-flight (ToF) measurements and robot states together with future reference information to determine the active locomotion mode. 2) a reinforcement learning control policy for trajectory tracking. The policy combines proprioceptive observations with future reference information to anticipate trajectory changes. For ground locomotion, multi-terrain training and dynamics randomization enable robust tracking across different terrains. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate reliable air-ground switching under limited perception and accurate ground tracking across diverse terrain conditions. The learned selector outperforms a rule-based mode selector in challenging transitions, while the ground controller achieves lower position RMSE than PID across all tested conditions and maintains decent tracking where NMPC fails. With these capabilities integrated, the system tracks a 101m air-ground trajectory through multiple autonomous mode transitions with a position RMSE of 0.08m.
items.abstract_zh: 被动轮式陆空双模态车辆（TABV）将空中机动性与高能效地面移动相结合。然而，面向真实世界应用时，在有限的机载感知下实现可靠的空中-地面模式切换，以及在多样地形上实现鲁棒的地面轨迹跟踪，仍然具有挑战性。本文提出一种面向被动轮式TABV的基于学习的空中-地面运动控制框架：1）用于自主空中-地面运动模式切换的学习型模式选择器。该选择器利用历史单点飞行时间（ToF）测量和机器人状态，并结合未来参考信息来确定当前激活的运动模式。2）用于轨迹跟踪的强化学习控制策略。该策略将本体感知观测与未来参考信息相结合，以预判轨迹变化。对于地面移动，多地形训练和动力学随机化使系统能够在不同地形上实现鲁棒跟踪。仿真和真实世界实验表明，系统在有限感知下能够可靠地进行空中-地面切换，并在多样地形条件下实现准确的地面跟踪。在具有挑战性的转换中，学习型选择器优于基于规则的模式选择器；而地面控制器在所有测试条件下均取得比PID更低的位置RMSE，并在NMPC失败的情况下仍保持不错的跟踪性能。集成这些能力后，系统跟踪了一条101m的空中-地面轨迹，经过多次自主模式切换，位置RMSE为0.08m。

items.title_en: Model-Based Systems Engineering Framework for SysML-Driven Design of Autonomous UAVs
items.title_zh: 面向SysML驱动的自主无人机设计的基于模型的系统工程框架
items.abstract_en: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are complex cyber-physical systems that require the coordinated integration of flight control, navigation, perception, communication, power management, and mission-level decision-making under safety, timing, and reliability constraints. However, many autonomous UAV development workflows still rely on document-centric requirements, separated architectural descriptions, and software implementation artifacts, which can lead to ambiguity, interface inconsistencies, and weak traceability during early design. This paper presents a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) design framework for the SysML-driven development of autonomous UAVs. The proposed framework uses the Systems Modeling Language (SysML) as a formal design backbone to structure UAV development across four connected layers: stakeholder requirements, functional decomposition, logical architecture, and physical/software allocation. SysML requirement diagrams, activity diagrams, block definition diagrams, internal block diagrams, state machine diagrams, and parametric diagrams are used to capture the functional, structural, behavioral, interface, and performance aspects of the UAV system. The logical architecture is then systematically mapped to a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) software architecture by relating SysML blocks to ROS 2 nodes, flow ports and connectors to topics, request-response interactions to services, and goal-oriented behaviors to actions. The framework is illustrated at the design level using representative autonomous UAV mission scenarios, including autonomous take-off, waypoint navigation, hover stabilization, obstacle avoidance, return-to-home, and emergency handling. The resulting model supports requirement allocation, interface definition, subsystem responsibility assignment, and verification planning before simulation or physical deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）是复杂的信息物理系统，需要在安全性、时序和可靠性约束下协调集成飞行控制、导航、感知、通信、电源管理和任务级决策。然而，许多自主无人机开发流程仍依赖以文档为中心的需求、分离的架构描述和软件实现制品，这可能在早期设计阶段导致歧义、接口不一致和可追溯性薄弱。本文提出一个基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）设计框架，用于SysML驱动的自主无人机开发。所提框架使用系统建模语言（SysML）作为形式化设计主干，将无人机开发组织为四个相互连接的层次：利益相关者需求、功能分解、逻辑架构以及物理/软件分配。使用SysML需求图、活动图、模块定义图、内部模块图、状态机图和参数图来捕获无人机系统的功能、结构、行为、接口和性能方面。随后，通过将SysML模块关联到ROS 2节点、将流端口和连接器关联到话题、将请求-响应交互关联到服务、将目标导向行为关联到动作，将逻辑架构系统地映射到机器人操作系统2（ROS 2）软件架构。该框架在设计层面使用具有代表性的自主无人机任务场景进行说明，包括自主起飞、航点导航、悬停稳定、避障、返航和应急处理。所得模型支持在仿真或物理部署之前进行需求分配、接口定义、子系统职责分配和验证规划。
items.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 International Conference on Autonomous Aerial Vehicles (ICAAV-2026), 20-21 Aug 2026, Bengaluru, India

items.title_en: LightSplat: Real-Time High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian SLAM with Loop Closure
items.title_zh: LightSplat：具有回环检测的实时高保真3D高斯SLAM
items.abstract_en: SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently demonstrated promising reconstruction accuracy for dense 3D scene representations. However, current 3DGS systems struggle to meet the strict demands of real-world deployments due to severe limitations in operational performance and map adaptability. To this end, we propose LightSplat, a hybrid-representation RGB-D SLAM framework. It synergizes local sparse features for robust and fast tracking with a dual-thread backend that progressively constructs dense Gaussian submaps. Crucially, we enable online loop closure through feature-accelerated 3DGS registration, refining overall map consistency through pose graph optimization. Ultimately, LightSplat achieves the online reconstruction of high-fidelity Gaussian map. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and real-world robotic platform demonstrate that our method achieves near state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and the capability to accommodate practical camera motions, maintaining an average framerate of 8 FPS. Overall, LightSplat provides an efficient and robust foundation for deploying high-fidelity 3DGS in real-world environments.
items.abstract_zh: 基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的SLAM系统近期在稠密3D场景表示的重建精度方面展现出良好前景。然而，当前3DGS系统在运行性能和地图适应性方面存在严重限制，难以满足实际部署的严格要求。为此，我们提出LightSplat，一种混合表示的RGB-D SLAM框架。它将局部稀疏特征用于稳健且快速的跟踪，并与逐步构建稠密高斯基图的双线程后端协同工作。关键的是，我们通过特征加速的3DGS配准实现在线回环检测，并通过位姿图优化提升整体地图一致性。最终，LightSplat实现在线高保真高斯地图重建。在多个数据集和真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明，我们的方法达到接近最先进的重建质量，并能适应实际相机运动，平均帧率为8 FPS。总体而言，LightSplat为在真实环境中部署高保真3DGS提供了高效且稳健的基础。
items.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

items.title_en: Dijkstra as an Oracle for Online Stochastic Shortest Path Navigation with Provable Guarantees
items.title_zh: Dijkstra作为具有可证明保证的在线随机最短路径导航预言机
items.abstract_en: Mobile robots that operate in side by side with humans and critical facilities must reach their goals at low cost, despite often unknown true traversal costs of the map apriori and imperfect actuation. Planners that solve the underlying stochastic shortest path problem exactly, such as value iteration, require computation that grows with the diameter of the map, whereas Dijkstra's algorithm is fast but is usually considered inexact once transitions are stochastic. This study shows that Dijkstra's algorithm can remain an exact planning engine under a condition that is much weaker than the causality condition often invoked in the literature, namely nonnegativity of a reduced cost defined on the determinized map. Building on this characterization, an online learner DORA (Dijkstra Oracle Reduced-cost Algorithm) is proposed for robot navigation that calls a shortest path oracle a fixed number of times per episode, never estimates a transition kernel, and adds a logarithmic survival weight when the probability of contact with a dynamic obstacle must stay within a budget. In the numerical experiments involving three other benchmarks that cover grid world navigation, directional drilling, and drone surveillance, the learner matches optimistic value iteration that is given the true transition kernel while performing 4.5 to 19.3 times less planner work, reduces contacts during learning by a factor of seventeen relative to determinize and replan, and keeps the contact rate within budgets that span two orders of magnitude. These results indicate that shortest path search supports safe and efficient online navigation and path planning tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 与人类和关键设施并肩运行的移动机器人必须在低代价下到达目标，尽管地图的真实通行代价通常先验未知且执行不完美。精确求解底层随机最短路径问题的规划器（如值迭代）所需计算量随地图直径增长，而Dijkstra算法虽快，但一旦转移具有随机性，通常被认为不再精确。本研究表明，在一个比文献中常引用的因果性条件弱得多的条件下，Dijkstra算法仍可作为精确规划引擎，即在确定化地图上定义的降成本（reduced cost）的非负性。基于这一刻画，提出一种在线学习器DORA（Dijkstra Oracle Reduced-cost Algorithm），用于机器人导航，其每个回合以固定次数调用最短路径预言机，从不估计转移核，并在与动态障碍物接触的概率必须保持在预算内时加入对数生存权重。在涉及网格世界导航、定向钻探和无人机监视的三个其他基准的数值实验中，该学习器在规划器工作量少4.5至19.3倍的情况下，达到与给定真实转移核的乐观值迭代相当的性能，相对于确定化并重新规划将学习期间的接触次数降至其1/17，并将接触率保持在跨越两个数量级的预算内。这些结果表明，最短路径搜索可支持安全高效的在线导航与路径规划任务。

items.title_en: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
items.title_zh: GenCOPE：面向机器人抓取的Syn2Real广义类别级物体位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.
items.abstract_zh: 类别级物体位姿估计（COPE）能够泛化到类内未知物体，已成为机器人3D场景理解的核心技术。然而，现有COPE方法仍需要为新颖物体类别费力地重新收集真实世界训练数据，这限制了其在实际应用中的可扩展性。本文旨在实现合成到现实（Syn2Real）泛化的COPE，即模型仅使用渲染的合成数据训练，并直接泛化到真实世界部署。核心挑战在于合成数据与真实世界数据之间的显著域差距，特别是在纹理外观方面。为解决此问题，我们旨在通过学习捕获同一类别内物体间语义共性的域不变表示来增强域泛化。我们引入2D和3D语义一致性约束，以降低特征编码器对域特定特征的敏感性。此外，我们提出一种端到端位姿回归框架，执行2D-3D交叉一致性学习，利用密集跨模态融合进一步细化位姿估计。由于简单性和有效性对真实世界机器人部署至关重要，我们的模型仅基于全局特征运行，形成高度轻量且高效的架构。在REAL275和Wild6D基准以及真实世界机器人操作场景上的大量实验表明，我们的范式具有优越的Syn2Real泛化性能。代码和演示发布于https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/。
items.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS'26

items.title_en: End-to-End Safe Social Navigation via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning and Probabilistic Perception
items.title_zh: 基于多任务强化学习与概率感知的端到端安全社交导航
items.abstract_en: Autonomous social navigation requires balancing efficiency, physical safety, and social compliance. Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods provide a viable and effective solution but often rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as the knowledge of humans' position and velocity. In this paper, we introduce JESSI (JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation), a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans directly to kinematically feasible control commands. JESSI enhances safety via Dirichlet-parameterized continuous action spaces and deterministic bounding, while an integrated attention-based perception module extracts probabilistic human states for interpretable, socially aware decision-making. Through extensive simulations and real-world deployment on a differential-drive robot, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing the RL policy with a supervised perception signal in a multi-task paradigm enhances social behavior. Ultimately, JESSI is able to balance high navigation success rates and superior social behaviors compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 自主社交导航需要平衡效率、物理安全与社交合规。强化学习（RL）方法提供了可行且有效的方案，但常依赖不现实的假设，例如已知人的位置与速度。本文提出 JESSI（JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation），一个轻量级端到端 RL 框架，直接把原始 LiDAR 扫描映射为运动学可行的控制指令。JESSI 通过 Dirichlet 参数化的连续动作空间与确定性边界约束增强安全性，同时集成的注意力感知模块可提取概率化的人体状态，实现可解释、具社交意识的决策。通过大量仿真与差速驱动机器人的真实部署，我们表明在多任务范式中将 RL 策略与监督感知信号联合优化能提升社交行为。最终，JESSI 相比最先进基线能兼顾高导航成功率与更优的社交行为。
items.highlight_zh: 不用真值人位姿，LiDAR端到端RL+概率感知实现安全社交导航
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：机器人在有人群的环境中穿行，既要快、要不撞人，还得符合社交礼仪（例如不要从两人中间硬挤过去）。强化学习是主流方案，但许多工作假设机器人“知道”每个人的精确位置和速度——现实中这需要额外的追踪系统，而且常常不准。
2) 方法：作者提出 JESSI，一个基于 JAX 的轻量端到端框架：输入是原始 LiDAR 扫描，输出直接是运动学可行的速度指令，中间不需要人工设计的地图或人体追踪器。安全性靠两点保障：用 Dirichlet 分布参数化连续动作空间，并对动作施加确定性上界约束；社交性则靠一个注意力感知模块，从传感器数据推断“概率化”的人体状态（位置与速度的分布而非单一数值），既让决策更保守安全，也带来可解释性。感知模块用监督信号训练，并与 RL 策略在多任务框架下联合优化。
3) 结果：大量仿真加上差速驱动机器人的实车部署表明，与纯 RL 相比，联合监督感知信号能明显改善社交行为；整体上 JESSI 在导航成功率与社交指标上均优于当前最强基线。
4) 为何重要：它把感知不确定性直接纳入策略学习，用便宜的单线 LiDAR 就实现了安全且懂礼貌的导航，降低了社交导航在真实机器人上落地的门槛。
items.comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026

items.title_en: PILOT: Privileged Imitation Learning for End-to-End Motion Planning of Autonomous UAVs under Partial Observability
items.title_zh: PILOT：部分可观测条件下自主无人机端到端运动规划的特权模仿学习
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in cluttered environments is hampered by partial observability and dynamic constraints. This paper presents PILOT, a constraint-aware privileged imitation learning framework for vision-based end-to-end UAV motion planning under partial observability. The framework distills planning strategies from a computationally intensive optimal control expert into a student policy regularized toward safety and dynamic requirements via a dual-objective loss function. To mitigate partial observability, a spatiotemporal perception fusion module using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is developed to integrate historical depth images and odometry. This module infers task-relevant latent context from historical observations, enhancing spatial awareness beyond the instantaneous FOV without maintaining persistent map memory. A trajectory parameterization layer mapping network outputs to a structured trajectory, while enabling explicit continuity, dynamic-consistency, and obstacle soft penalties during training, encouraging constraint satisfaction for unseen observations without formal guarantees. Simulations on quadrotor and fixed-wing aircraft demonstrate that PILOT achieves performance comparable to the privileged expert while reducing computational overhead by over 80\%. Successful indoor and outdoor zero-shot deployment confirms the practical feasibility and cross-domain generalization of the planner.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的自主导航受到部分可观测性和动态约束的阻碍。本文提出 PILOT，一个约束感知的特权模仿学习框架，用于部分可观测条件下基于视觉的无人机端到端运动规划。该框架将计算密集的最优控制专家的规划策略蒸馏到学生策略中，并通过双目标损失函数对学生策略朝着安全和动态要求进行正则化。为缓解部分可观测性，开发了一个使用时间卷积网络（TCN）的时空感知融合模块，以融合历史深度图像和里程计。该模块从历史观测中推断任务相关的潜在上下文，在不维护持久地图记忆的情况下增强超出瞬时视场的空间感知。轨迹参数化层将网络输出映射为结构化轨迹，同时在训练期间启用显式连续性、动态一致性和障碍物软惩罚，鼓励对未见观测满足约束，但无形式化保证。在四旋翼和固定翼飞机上的仿真表明，PILOT 达到与特权专家相当的性能，同时将计算开销降低超过 80%。成功的室内外零样本部署证实了该规划器的实际可行性和跨域泛化能力。

items.title_en: TrackFish3D: Self-Supervised 3D Tracking of Schooling Fish from Multi-view Videos
items.title_zh: TrackFish3D：基于多视角视频的鱼群自监督3D跟踪
items.abstract_en: Quantifying collective fish behavior requires accurate trajectories, yet multi-view 3D tracking remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, visually similar individuals, and the long-standing scarcity of identity annotations. We present TrackFish3D, a geometry-driven self-supervised framework for dense multi-camera 3D tracking of schooling fish. Instead of relying on appearance-based re-identification or manually annotated identities, TrackFish3D turns calibrated multi-view geometry into supervision: triangulation and reprojection consistency provide pseudo-associations, while a geometric encoder and global association transformer learn all-to-all cross-view correspondence within each frame. To make these associations identity-aware, TrackFish3D introduces a self-supervised contrastive objective that separates co-visible individuals in the embedding space, together with a temporal predictor that preserves identities and bridges short occlusions across frames. The resulting model is trained once on unlabeled footage and applied directly to unseen test videos, requiring no cross-view identity labels, temporal annotations, 3D ground truth, appearance features, or test-time optimization. On our benchmark, TrackFish3D improves 3D Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy from 87.7% for the strongest baseline to 95.8%. On the 3D-ZeF zebrafish benchmark, it achieves 81.1% MOTA, compared with 77.4% for the best geometric baseline. TrackFish3D also generalizes beyond fish, achieving strong results on real-world bird tracking.
items.abstract_zh: 量化鱼类集体行为需要准确轨迹，然而由于频繁遮挡、视觉上相似的个体以及长期缺乏身份标注，多视角3D跟踪仍然具有挑战性。我们提出TrackFish3D，一种几何驱动的自监督框架，用于鱼群的密集多相机3D跟踪。TrackFish3D不依赖基于外观的重识别或人工标注身份，而是将标定后的多视角几何转化为监督：三角测量和重投影一致性提供伪关联，而几何编码器和全局关联Transformer学习每帧内全对全的跨视角对应。为使这些关联具有身份感知能力，TrackFish3D引入自监督对比目标，在嵌入空间中分离共同可见的个体，并引入时间预测器以保持身份并跨帧桥接短时遮挡。所得模型在无标注视频上训练一次，并直接应用于未见测试视频，无需跨视角身份标签、时间标注、3D真值、外观特征或测试时优化。在我们的基准上，TrackFish3D将3D多目标跟踪准确率从最强基线的87.7%提升到95.8%。在3D-ZeF斑马鱼基准上，它达到81.1%的MOTA，而最佳几何基线为77.4%。TrackFish3D还泛化到鱼类之外，在真实世界鸟类跟踪上取得强结果。

items.title_en: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
items.title_zh: 教一棵树恢复：利用反事实回放的LLM监督器在线蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人通常将全局规划器与局部模型预测控制器（MPC）配对，但非凸避障和有限时域可能导致机器人在复杂布局中冻结。决定是重新规划、等待还是求助，是一项监督决策。近期工作在每个异常发生时都查询大语言模型（LLM）监督器，这既慢又昂贵。我们改为将LLM在线蒸馏为决策树。在每个训练回合后，反事实回放将恢复操作标注为需要、不必要或有害。这些标签会淘汰无用的规则。在仿真中，对于仅靠MPC会冻结的20个未见布局，该决策树在所有随机种子下至少正确处理18个，要么到达目标，要么在不存在可行路径时求助。该决策树与始终查询的LLM监督器和专家设计的规则均相匹配，同时在测试时不发出任何LLM查询。手写规则无法预见物理机器人将遇到的长尾情况。在线蒸馏是一种有前景的补救方法：决策树处理熟悉情况，仅对新情况咨询LLM，而经过验证的恢复操作会成为新规则。因此，语言模型也可以充当监督器的设计者，而不仅是运行时监督器。

items.title_en: WAND: Learning Robust Navigation under Complex Wind Disturbances and Dense Obstacles for Quadrotors
items.title_zh: WAND：面向四旋翼在复杂风扰动和密集障碍物下学习鲁棒导航
items.abstract_en: Robust navigation in cluttered environments remains a fundamental challenge for quadrotors, particularly when strong wind disturbances arise, which perturb vehicle dynamics, limit control authority, and substantially increase collision risk. Existing learning-based navigation policies typically rely on obstacle perception and proprioceptive observations, requiring the policy to infer time-varying disturbance effects implicitly and thereby limiting robustness under partial observability. This paper proposes WAND (Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation), a reinforcement learning framework for navigation under time-varying wind disturbances in dense obstacle fields. Specifically, WAND estimates wind-induced disturbance acceleration from historical proprioceptive states using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This estimation is integrated into the policy via a zero-initialized residual module, \emph{WindAdapter}, while simultaneously providing feedforward compensation for low-level control. The dual use of the estimate couples disturbance-conditioned navigation with feedforward disturbance rejection. Across 12 wind-disturbed simulation settings, WAND improved the observed success rate by 8.3 percentage points on average relative to feedforward compensation alone. Controlled opposite-crosswind experiments further showed wind-direction-dependent trajectory adaptation. In indoor fan-induced flight tests, WAND succeeded in 18 of 20 trials, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time onboard navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 在杂乱环境中鲁棒导航仍是四旋翼的基本挑战，尤其当出现强风扰动时，风扰动会扰动飞行器动力学、限制控制权限，并显著增加碰撞风险。现有基于学习的导航策略通常依赖障碍物感知和本体感受观测，要求策略隐式推断时变扰动效应，从而在部分可观测下限制鲁棒性。本文提出 WAND（Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation），一个用于密集障碍场中时变风扰动下导航的强化学习框架。具体而言，WAND 使用时间卷积网络（TCN）从历史本体感受状态估计风引起的扰动加速度。该估计通过零初始化残差模块 WindAdapter 集成到策略中，同时为低层控制提供前馈补偿。该估计的双重用途将扰动条件导航与前馈扰动抑制耦合。在 12 种受风扰动仿真设置中，WAND 相对于仅前馈补偿将观测成功率平均提高 8.3 个百分点。受控反向侧风实验进一步显示了风方向相关的轨迹适应。在室内风扇诱导飞行测试中，WAND 在 20 次试验中成功 18 次，证明了实时机载导航的可行性。

items.title_en: Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception
items.title_zh: 从信念行动，在需要时观察：间歇感知下导航的贝叶斯空间世界模型
items.abstract_en: Robot navigation commonly uses wide-coverage, high-frequency sensing to reduce partial observability; this reliance becomes restrictive when another task temporarily redirects a shared sensor from navigation, interrupting navigation-relevant observations. We study navigation under intermittent perception: acting from an internal spatial belief and looking again only when execution needs a new observation, potentially freeing the shared sensor for other tasks between navigation observations. ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model, propagates a structured spatial belief using executed actions and corrects it with selectively acquired observations; learned priors over common geometric structures infer unobserved structure from available observation history. It decodes the belief into a spatial estimate for the motion-planning module and predicts a reliability map expressing confidence in the estimate's accuracy. ALONE requests an observation only if insufficient reliability hinders navigation and new evidence should make relevant-region spatial information more reliable; otherwise, it continues acting from the propagated belief. We instantiate ALONE for drone navigation with intermittent single-camera depth images. Across two simulated scene families, it achieves 98% and 97% closed-loop success at a 10 Hz decision rate. Among successful trials, median fractions of decision steps requiring a new depth observation are only 0.9% and 1.3%, respectively, demonstrating high navigation success with substantially reduced observation demand. Real-world indoor flight experiments further validate navigation under intermittent depth observations, with all 10 trials successful.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人导航通常使用广覆盖、高频传感来减少部分可观测性；当另一个任务临时将共享传感器从导航重定向、打断导航相关观测时，这种依赖变得受限。我们研究间歇感知下的导航：从内部空间信念行动，并仅当执行需要新观测时才再次观察，从而可能在导航观测之间将共享传感器释放给其他任务。ALONE，一个贝叶斯空间世界模型，使用已执行动作传播结构化空间信念，并用选择性获取的观测校正它；关于常见几何结构的学习先验从可用观测历史推断未观测结构。它将信念解码为运动规划模块的空间估计，并预测表示该估计准确性置信度的可靠性图。ALONE 仅在可靠性不足妨碍导航且新证据应使相关区域空间信息更可靠时请求观测；否则，它继续从传播的信念行动。我们实例化 ALONE 用于具有间歇单相机深度图像的无人机导航。在两个模拟场景族中，它在 10 Hz 决策率下分别达到 98% 和 97% 的闭环成功率。在成功试验中，需要新深度观测的决策步骤中位数比例分别仅为 0.9% 和 1.3%，表明在显著降低观测需求的同时实现高导航成功率。真实世界室内飞行实验进一步验证了间歇深度观测下的导航，10 次试验全部成功。

items.title_en: Pedicel-Targeted Strawberry Harvesting via Imitation Learning on a Low-Cost Teleoperated Robotic Arm
items.title_zh: 基于低成本遥操作机械臂模仿学习的果梗靶向草莓采摘
items.abstract_en: Precise pedicel-targeted grasping in strawberry harvesting remains a critical bottleneck due to the pedicel's small diameter (1.3-3 mm), color similarity with surrounding foliage, and precise force control required for clean abscission zone detachment. As a market-grade crop, strawberry aesthetic value makes bruise-free pedicel detachment essential over direct fruit grasping. Classical approaches struggle to unify vision models, motion planning, and contact manipulation into a robust framework, particularly in occluded canopy environments. Therefore, this work presents a visuomotor imitation learning pipeline for pedicel-targeted strawberry harvesting that unifies perception, motion planning, and contact manipulation from collecting human teleoperation demonstrations, training an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy with a ResNet-50 visual backbone, and deploying the learned policy autonomously on a Jetson AGX Orin edge platform at 15 Hz. The trained policy achieved consistent loss convergence from 2.84 to 0.091 over 100K gradient steps on 130 demonstrations. We have also established a reproducible open-source pipeline with publicly released dataset and model weights for the agricultural robotics community. Full dataset is available at, https://huggingface.co/datasets/nitindominicrai/strawberry_pedicel_grasp_teleoperation and trained policy at, https://huggingface.co/nitindominicrai/act_strawberry_pedicel. To replicate this work, all code, configurations, and deployment instructions are publicly available at, https://github.com/nitin-dominic/autonomous_strawberry_pedicel_harvesting.
items.abstract_zh: 草莓采摘中花梗直径仅 1.3–3 mm、与周围枝叶颜色相近，且需精确力控才能干净切断离层，使花梗靶向抓取成为关键瓶颈；作为商品性作物，无损伤的花梗分离比直接抓取果实更重要。传统方法难以把视觉模型、运动规划与接触操作统一为鲁棒框架，在遮挡冠层中尤为困难。为此，本文提出视觉运动模仿学习流程：采集人类遥操作示范，训练以 ResNet-50 为视觉骨干的 ACT（Action Chunking with Transformers）策略，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘平台以 15 Hz 自主部署。130 条示范、10 万梯度步内损失由 2.84 收敛至 0.091。数据集、模型权重与代码均已公开，形成可复现的开源流程。
items.highlight_zh: 用 ACT 模仿学习让低成本机械臂在边缘端 15 Hz 自主采草莓花梗
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：草莓若直接抓果实容易压伤、影响商品价值，因此应抓住直径仅 1.3–3 mm 的花梗，并在离层处干净分离。但花梗极细、颜色与枝叶相近、常被遮挡，还需精确控力，传统“视觉模型＋运动规划＋接触控制”的分模块方案在遮挡冠层中很难稳定整合。
方法：作者采用端到端模仿学习。先用低成本遥操作机械臂采集 130 条人类示范，训练 ACT（Action Chunking with Transformers）策略，视觉骨干为 ResNet-50；再把学到的策略部署到 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘平台，以 15 Hz 自主运行。
结果：训练在 10 万梯度步内使损失由 2.84 稳定降到 0.091，说明策略能较好地拟合示范。作者同时完整开源了数据集、模型权重、代码与部署说明，形成可复现的流程。
为何重要：一是把感知、规划与接触操作统一进一个可学习策略，绕开了模块化管线在细小目标上难以对接的问题；二是验证了低成本硬件加边缘算力即可跑通精细农业操作；三是开源降低了农业机器人社区复现与横向比较的门槛。需要说明的是，文中主要报告训练收敛与部署流程，尚未给出大规模田间采摘成功率的统计。
items.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures. This paper was peer-reviewed and accepted in the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), "From Innovation to Adoption: Hardware, AI, Policy, and Funding Challenges in Agricultural Robotics Workshop," Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, 2026

items.title_en: CAOS-SLAM: Class-Agnostic Object-Aware Real-Time vSLAM for Dynamic Environments
items.title_zh: CAOS-SLAM：面向动态环境的类别无关物体感知实时vSLAM
items.abstract_en: Robust visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (vSLAM) in dynamic environments faces challenges due to the presence of moving objects that may introduce erroneous observations, corrupt the map reconstruction and overall degrade localization accuracy. Existing vSLAM approaches often rely on predefined semantic classes or costly pixel-wise classification, limiting their robustness or applicability in real-world scenarios. This paper presents CAOS-SLAM, a dynamic vSLAM framework that extends ORB-SLAM3 with a hybrid perception pipeline to detect, track, and filter both semantically known and previously unseen moving objects in real-time. On-demand panoptic segmentation is performed for object discovery, with candidate unknown objects instantiated through depth-based clustering of unclassified regions. Between panoptic updates, persistent object tracks are updated using lightweight detection when available or temporal mask propagation based on world-frame Kalman prediction, depth consistency, and appearance similarity. The estimated object motion is then used to reject dynamic features from the SLAM pipeline. Experimental results on multiple dynamic RGB-D datasets and real-world experiments demonstrate improved localization accuracy over state-of-the-art dynamic vSLAM approaches, achieving up to 59% lower localization error in scenes characterized by unknown dynamic objects and up to 88% lower error in heavily occluded scenes, while achieving a median processing rate of 30 FPS on a laptop. Furthermore, the tracking module provides estimates of object trajectories and velocities, supporting potential future applications in perception, navigation, and motion-planning tasks in dynamic environments. Code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 动态环境中的稳健视觉同时定位与建图（vSLAM）面临挑战，因为运动物体可能引入错误观测、破坏地图重建并整体降低定位精度。现有vSLAM方法通常依赖预定义语义类别或昂贵的逐像素分类，限制了其在真实场景中的稳健性或适用性。本文提出CAOS-SLAM，一种动态vSLAM框架，它在ORB-SLAM3基础上扩展了混合感知流水线，以实时检测、跟踪并过滤语义已知和先前未见的运动物体。按需执行全景分割以发现对象，并通过未分类区域的深度聚类实例化候选未知对象。在全景更新之间，持久对象轨迹通过可用时的轻量检测或基于世界坐标系Kalman预测、深度一致性和外观相似性的时序掩码传播进行更新。估计的对象运动随后用于从SLAM流水线中剔除动态特征。在多个动态RGB-D数据集和真实世界实验上的结果表明，相比最先进的动态vSLAM方法，定位精度得到提升：在以未知动态物体为特征的场景中定位误差最多降低59%，在严重遮挡场景中误差最多降低88%，同时在笔记本电脑上达到30 FPS的中位处理速率。此外，跟踪模块提供对象轨迹和速度估计，支持动态环境中感知、导航和运动规划任务的潜在未来应用。代码和数据集将在录用后发布。

items.title_en: LEAP-CBF: A Safety Filter for Uncertain Systems with Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials
items.title_zh: LEAP-CBF：一种具有最小努力对抗势的不确定系统安全滤波器
items.abstract_en: Control barrier functions (CBF) are a popular safety filter to ensure safety for nonlinear dynamical systems. However, when the system is subject to uncertainties and disturbances, this requires the use of robust variants of CBFs, which can be difficult to construct and can be overly conservative, especially for high-dimensional systems under input constraints. In this work, we propose a new approach to solve these challenges by introducing Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP), a certificate that quantifies the robustness of a given state against disturbances in terms of the effort required by the disturbance to cause failure. We show that LEAP is a CBF for the undisturbed system, but can also be used to construct a safety filter that is robust to disturbances whose cumulative effort is bounded. We propose a method for constructing LEAPs with on-policy deep reinforcement learning. Next, we demonstrate LEAPs in simulation on a variety of multi-agent systems with disturbances and uncertainties. Finally, hardware experiments on a quadruped and quadrotors validate that LEAPs are well suited to tackle the disturbances and uncertainties from real-world robotic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 控制屏障函数（CBF）是一种流行的安全滤波器，用于确保非线性动力系统的安全性。然而，当系统受到不确定性和扰动时，这需要使用 CBF 的鲁棒变体，而此类变体可能难以构造，并且可能过于保守，尤其是对于输入约束下的高维系统。在本工作中，我们提出一种新方法来解决这些挑战，引入最小努力对抗势（LEAP），这是一种证书，以扰动导致失败所需的努力来量化给定状态对扰动的鲁棒性。我们表明，LEAP 是无扰动系统的 CBF，但也可用于构造对累积努力有界扰动具有鲁棒性的安全滤波器。我们提出一种使用同策略深度强化学习构造 LEAP 的方法。接下来，我们在具有扰动和不确定性的多种多智能体系统上通过仿真演示 LEAP。最后，在四足机器人和四旋翼上的硬件实验验证了 LEAP 非常适合处理真实机器人系统中的扰动和不确定性。

items.title_en: Onboard Wind-Preview Model Predictive Control Using Pitot-Static Sensing for Multirotor UAVs
items.title_zh: 用于多旋翼无人机的基于皮托静压传感的机载风预览模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Effective wind gust rejection and stable hovering are critical for the outdoor operation of autonomous drones. However, existing gust rejection methods are primarily reactive, inferring the disturbance from the resulting motion or measuring it at the airframe. Either way, the wind has already begun to act before it can be compensated. In this work, we anticipate the gust instead by measuring the wind ahead of the drone with a low-cost, low-weight pitot-static sensor mounted on a boom. The resulting wind preview is incorporated into a nonlinear model predictive controller (MPC), which optimizes the drone motion while anticipating wind disturbances. A longer boom offers more preview time but adds inertia and degrades flight performance. We characterize this trade-off in simulation and show that the optimal preview distance is not a fixed property of the platform, but shifts with the wind speed and with how quickly the drone can respond. Indoor hardware experiments confirm the trend and show that the proposed controller substantially improves hover performance against a PX4 baseline and an otherwise identical wind-unaware MPC. Outdoor experiments show that the error along the wind direction is reduced by 54 percent with respect to the baseline, demonstrating that a single wind-aligned sensor can significantly improve hovering performance.
items.abstract_zh: 有效的阵风抑制和稳定悬停对于自主无人机的户外作业至关重要。然而，现有的阵风抑制方法主要是反应式的，要么从由此产生的运动推断扰动，要么在机体上测量扰动。无论哪种方式，在能够补偿之前风已经开始作用。在本工作中，我们改为通过在无人机前方安装于支杆上的低成本、轻重量皮托-静压传感器测量风来预判阵风。由此获得的风预视被纳入非线性模型预测控制器（MPC），该控制器在预判风扰动的同时优化无人机运动。更长的支杆提供更多的预视时间，但会增加惯量并降低飞行性能。我们在仿真中刻画了这一权衡，并表明最优预视距离不是平台的固定属性，而是随风速以及无人机响应速度而变化。室内硬件实验证实了这一趋势，并表明所提出的控制器相对于PX4基线和在其他方面相同但不感知风的MPC，显著提高了悬停性能。户外实验表明，沿风向的误差相对于基线降低了54%，证明单个与风向对齐的传感器可以显著提高悬停性能。

items.title_en: An Adaptive Control Architecture for Slope and Terrain Compensation in Autonomous Navigation in Mediterranean Greenhouses
items.title_zh: 地中海温室自主导航中用于坡度和地形补偿的自适应控制架构
items.abstract_en: The ability to move stably over terrain with varying slopes and textures is essential for mobile agricultural robots operating in complex and dynamic environments such as greenhouses, where small terrain irregularities can lead to significant navigation errors. This article presents a novel terrain-adaptation strategy based on the carried payload, ensuring accurate and robust trajectory tracking. The proposed approach is based on: (i) the experimental characterization of the most common types of greenhouse soil, concrete, compacted sand, and gravel, and (ii) the direct measurement of terrain slope using the IMU, in order to estimate the force with which this angle affects the motor input. Based on this information, a cascade trajectory-tracking scheme has been designed, consisting of a model-based predictive controller (MPC) in the outer loop and a PI controller in the inner loop. The system incorporates an adaptive feedforward control through gain scheduling approach, capable of adjusting to disturbances caused by variations in slope and terrain type. Simulation results demonstrate that the differential-drive robot achieves a significant improvement both in error indices and in control signal efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
items.abstract_zh: 能够在不平坦且纹理多变的地形上稳定移动，对于在地中海温室等复杂动态环境中运行的移动农业机器人至关重要，因为微小的地形不规则可能导致显著的导航误差。本文提出一种基于所承载载荷的新地形自适应策略，以确保准确且鲁棒的轨迹跟踪。所提方法基于：（i）对最常见的温室土壤、混凝土、压实沙和砾石类型进行实验表征；以及（ii）利用IMU直接测量地形坡度，以估计该角度对电机输入施加的作用力。基于这些信息，设计了一种级联轨迹跟踪方案，由外环的基于模型的预测控制器（MPC）和内环的PI控制器组成。系统通过增益调度方法纳入自适应前馈控制，能够适应由坡度和地形类型变化引起的扰动。仿真结果表明，差速驱动机器人在误差指标和控制信号效率两方面均取得显著改善，突出了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

items.title_en: Continual Learning for Traversability Prediction with Uncertainty-Aware Adaptation
items.title_zh: 具有不确定性感知适应的可通行性预测持续学习
items.abstract_en: Traversability prediction is a critical component of autonomous navigation in unstructured environments, where complex and uncertain robot-terrain interactions pose significant challenges such as traction loss and dynamic instability. Despite recent progress in learning-based traversability prediction, these methods often fail to adapt to novel terrains. Even when adaptation is achieved, retaining experience from previously trained environments remains a challenge, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose a continual learning framework for traversability prediction that incrementally adapts to new terrains using a generative experience recall model. A key virtue of the proposed framework is two folds: i) retain prior experience without storing past data; and ii) incorporate the uncertainty of the generated samples from the recall model, enabling uncertainty-aware adaptation. Real-world experiments with a skid-steering robot validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, demonstrating its ability to adapt across a series of diverse environments while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
items.abstract_zh: 可通行性预测是非结构化环境中自主导航的关键组成部分，其中复杂且不确定的机器人-地形交互带来牵引力损失和动态不稳定等重大挑战。尽管基于学习的可通行性预测近期取得进展，这些方法往往无法适应新地形。即使实现了适应，保留先前训练环境的经验仍然是一个挑战，即灾难性遗忘问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种可通行性预测的持续学习框架，使用生成式经验回放模型增量适应新地形。所提框架的关键优点有两点：i）在不存储过去数据的情况下保留先前经验；ii）纳入回放模型生成样本的不确定性，从而实现不确定性感知适应。使用滑移转向机器人的真实世界实验验证了所提框架的有效性，证明其能够在一系列多样环境中适应，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
