items.title_en: NIDAR: NIR-Guided Intrinsic Decomposition for Scalable Scene-Agnostic LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction
items.title_zh: NIDAR：面向可扩展场景无关LiDAR强度重建的NIR引导本征分解
items.abstract_en: LiDAR return intensity provides complementary surface-response cues for robotic perception and state estimation, yet many simulation pipelines omit it or reproduce it using reconstruction methods that require real intensity supervision and per-scene optimization. These requirements increase data-collection and fitting costs and limit reuse across simulated scenes. We present NIDAR, a feed-forward framework that synthesizes dense intensity-like observations from RGB appearance and simulator geometry. NIDAR combines pretrained pseudo-NIR translation, hierarchical intrinsic decomposition, geometry-aware modulation, and source-domain distribution calibration to transfer reflectance-related image cues to simulated point clouds. Its learned components are trained offline using Waymo data; their weights and calibration remain fixed during evaluation on Waymo and nuScenes. Deployment therefore requires neither target-scene intensity labels nor target-scene gradient-based fitting. The reported comparisons show competitive pixel-wise accuracy and favorable structural and perceptual fidelity against the evaluated reconstruction baselines. A controlled pseudo-NIR-versus-RGB diagnostic further shows that the pseudo-NIR prior is most beneficial when used through the paper-aligned reflectance-and-remapping route, rather than as a simple direct intensity regressor. We further integrate NIDAR with Unreal Engine 5, Isaac Sim, and a generative LiDAR pipeline. Two intensity-aware SLAM systems evaluated in two simulated indoor scenes suggest potential downstream utility, but do not constitute real-robot validation. NIDAR therefore offers a scalable intensity-synthesis interface for the evaluated settings; cross-wavelength, camera-configuration, embedded, and real-sensor validation remain future work.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR回波强度为机器人感知和状态估计提供互补的表面响应线索，然而许多仿真流程会省略该信息，或使用需要真实强度监督和逐场景优化的重建方法来复现它。这些要求增加了数据采集与拟合成本，并限制了跨仿真场景的复用。我们提出NIDAR，一个前馈框架，从RGB外观和仿真器几何合成稠密的类强度观测。NIDAR结合预训练的伪近红外转换、分层本征分解、几何感知调制和源域分布校准，将与反射率相关的图像线索迁移到仿真点云。其学习组件使用Waymo数据离线训练；在Waymo和nuScenes上评估时，其权重和校准保持固定。因此，部署既不需要目标场景的强度标签，也不需要目标场景的基于梯度的拟合。所报告的对比显示，相对于所评估的重建基线，其具有有竞争力的逐像素精度以及良好的结构和感知保真度。一项受控的伪近红外与RGB对比诊断进一步表明，当通过论文中一致的反射率与重映射路径使用伪近红外先验时，其收益最大，而不是作为简单的直接强度回归器使用。我们进一步将NIDAR与Unreal Engine 5、Isaac Sim和一个生成式LiDAR流程集成。在两个仿真室内场景中评估的两个强度感知SLAM系统表明其具有潜在的下游用途，但不构成真实机器人验证。因此，NIDAR为所评估的设置提供了一种可扩展的强度合成接口；跨波长、相机配置、嵌入式以及真实传感器验证仍属于未来工作。
items.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

items.title_en: Beyond Terminal Constraints: Reliable Robot Control with Learned Safe Sets
items.title_zh: 超越终端约束：使用学习安全集的可靠机器人控制
items.abstract_en: Ensuring safety in advanced robot control methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning remains an open challenge. A common approach relies on control-invariant sets, yet their exact computation for nonlinear systems is generally intractable, and numerical approximations compromise theoretical guarantees. In this work, we show that safety does not need to rely exclusively on control invariance. We introduce novel classes of safe sets, each broader than classical control-invariant sets, and analyze corresponding MPC schemes that guarantee recursive feasibility by constraining different nodes of the prediction horizon rather than only the terminal state. Furthermore, when the safe set is an inner approximation of a suitable control-invariant set, our methods can ensure safety through a safe-abort strategy, even in the absence of recursive feasibility. We validate our approaches in extensive simulations on a 6-joint robot manipulator, showing fewer constraint violations than state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable tracking performance and computational efficiency. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the practicality of our schemes for real-world robotic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习等先进机器人控制方法中确保安全性仍是一个未解决的挑战。一种常见方法依赖控制不变集，但其对非线性系统的精确计算通常难以处理，数值近似会损害理论保证。在这项工作中，我们表明安全性不必仅依赖控制不变性。我们引入新的安全集类别，每一类都比经典控制不变集更广，并分析相应的 MPC 方案：这些方案通过约束预测时域的不同节点而非仅终端状态来保证递归可行性。此外，当安全集是合适控制不变集的内近似时，即使不存在递归可行性，我们的方法也能通过安全中止策略确保安全性。我们在 6 关节机械臂上进行大量仿真验证，结果表明，与最先进方法相比，我们的方法在保持相当跟踪性能和计算效率的同时，约束违反更少。硬件实验进一步证明了我们的方案在真实机器人应用中的实用性。

items.title_en: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
items.title_zh: 自然语言到Nav2：基于代价地图导航的操作策略
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission acceptance, and three costmap adapters project accepted policies into the existing navigation stack without changing its planner or controller. On 150 researcher-authored English commands, four local models produce 107-142 correct accepted policies, compared with 44 for a rule-based parser, with 3-20 incorrect acceptances per model. Fault injection records rejection of eight endpoint/JSON faults and 29 validator-stage faults. Navigation experiments use correct task policies to evaluate keepouts, zone costs, person-dependent regions, and event-conditioned passage in simulation and on a TurtleBot3. For Tasks 1-3, mean travel times are 18.4-24.5% lower in simulation and 23.1-35.0% lower on the physical testbed than with the baseline lacking those policies. A native KeepoutFilter comparison and two-robot demonstrations examine basic keepout behavior and shared policy projection. The interface connects operator instructions to explicit navigation policies while retaining Nav2's planning and control components.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人支持仓库和工业设施中的物料运输，在这些场景中，导航必须适应不断变化的运行条件。传感器观测可揭示物理障碍，但其本身并不规定操作人员已知的临时通行规则、路径偏好或例外情况。本文提出一种自然语言策略接口，将这些知识引入ROS 2 Nav2。一个本地大语言模型将指令转换为JSON策略，指定目的地、空间约束以及时间或事件条件。确定性检查控制任务是否被接受，三个代价地图适配器将接受的策略投影到现有导航栈中，而不改变其规划器或控制器。在150条由研究人员编写的英文命令上，四个本地模型生成107-142条正确且被接受的策略，而基于规则的解析器为44条；每个模型有3-20条错误接受。故障注入记录了八个端点/JSON故障和29个验证器阶段故障被拒绝。导航实验使用正确的任务策略，在仿真和TurtleBot3上评估禁行区、区域代价、依赖人员的区域以及事件条件通行。对于任务1-3，与缺少这些策略的基线相比，仿真中的平均行驶时间降低18.4-24.5%，物理测试平台上的平均行驶时间降低23.1-35.0%。一项原生KeepoutFilter比较和两个机器人演示考察了基本禁行区行为和共享策略投影。该接口将操作人员指令连接到显式导航策略，同时保留Nav2的规划与控制组件。

items.title_en: One year in a forest: Analyzing the challenges of autonomous navigation in subarctic environments
items.title_zh: 森林中的一年：分析亚北极环境中自主导航的挑战
items.abstract_en: Subarctic regions have the potential to see increased deployment of autonomous robots in applications including forestry, mining, and environmental monitoring. In these conditions, an autonomous system's reliance on GNSS or cloud computing is precarious due to dense tree canopies and atmospheric attenuation, necessitating onboard sensing and data processing. However, established exteroceptive modalities, including cameras, lidars, and radars, are typically evaluated in structured urban settings or in environments that lack significant seasonal variations. To address this, we present a field report on a year-long deployment of a mobile robot in a subarctic boreal forest. We evaluate 64 km of data using nine odometry, localization, and mapping methods and assess their performance across seasonal changes. The performed experiments suggest that the environment changes significantly hinder the performance of state-of-the-art techniques, which show increased fragility when subject to conditions characterized by self-similar scenes or tall snowbanks. Additionally, complex Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms offer limited accuracy gains over a proprioceptive baseline while significantly increasing system fragility. Furthermore, by correlating the position drift with features and confidence weight distribution, we show that visual-based SLAM methods are particularly affected by the seasonal changes. Additionally, we investigate the task of cross-season localization in a prior map. While lidar-based methods successfully completed localization runs between seasons, radar and visual methods are prone to failure due to a few matching features between runs, even within the same season. Finally, we detail the challenges and lessons learned from this year-long trial, including a multi-season Teach and Repeat (T&R) evaluation using both radar and lidar-based pipelines.
items.abstract_zh: 亚北极地区有望在林业、采矿和环境监测等应用中增加自主机器人的部署。在这些条件下，由于茂密树冠和大气衰减，自主系统对GNSS或云计算的依赖并不可靠，因而需要车载传感和数据处理。然而，包括相机、激光雷达和雷达在内的既有外感知模态通常在结构化城市环境或缺乏显著季节变化的环境中评估。为解决这一问题，我们呈现在亚北极北方针叶林中为期一年部署移动机器人的现场报告。我们使用九种里程计、定位和建图方法评估64 km数据，并评估其在季节变化下的性能。所进行的实验表明，环境变化显著阻碍最先进技术的性能，这些技术在自相似场景或高雪堆条件下表现出更高的脆弱性。此外，复杂的同时定位与建图（SLAM）算法相比本体感知基线仅提供有限的精度提升，同时显著增加系统脆弱性。进一步，通过将位置漂移与特征和置信权重分布相关联，我们表明基于视觉的SLAM方法尤其受季节变化影响。此外，我们研究在先验地图中的跨季节定位任务。虽然基于激光雷达的方法成功完成了季节间的定位运行，但雷达和视觉方法由于运行间匹配特征很少而容易失败，即使在同一季节内也是如此。最后，我们详述了从这一年试验中得到的挑战和经验教训，包括使用基于雷达和基于激光雷达的流水线进行的多季节示教与重复（Teach and Repeat, T&R）评估。

items.title_en: Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT) for Robot Navigation in Dense and Uncertain Crowds
items.title_zh: 用于密集和不确定人群中机器人导航的人-人及人-机器人交互Transformer（H2INT）
items.abstract_en: Safe robot navigation in dense crowds requires reasoning about pedestrian motion and how it may change in response to a robot. However, many learning-based approaches generate pedestrian motion independently of the robot or assume uniform reciprocity, omitting an important source of interaction uncertainty. This paper presents a Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT), a reinforcement learning framework that retains robot-conditioned changes in pedestrian motion during policy learning while allowing responsiveness to vary across pedestrians. Responsiveness affects the crowd dynamics when the robot is visible but is not supplied as a policy input; the policy must instead infer its consequences from robot-centered relative positions. A two-stage gated Transformer progressively encodes human-human and human-robot relations, while a recurrent policy captures their temporal evolution. A curriculum gradually reduces pedestrian responsiveness to increase interaction difficulty. Simulation experiments demonstrate improved navigation safety and robustness over representative baselines across response conditions and crowd densities, and show transfer without retraining to structurally distinct crowd-flow layouts. Ablations support the hierarchical relational encoding and gated updates. Real-robot deployment further verifies that the learned policy can operate with sparse observations in a physical environment.
items.abstract_zh: 在密集人群中实现安全的机器人导航，需要推理行人运动以及行人运动可能因机器人而如何变化。然而，许多基于学习的方法独立于机器人生成行人运动，或假设均匀的互惠性，从而遗漏了交互不确定性的重要来源。本文提出人类-人类与人类-机器人交互Transformer（H2INT），这是一种强化学习框架，在策略学习过程中保留由机器人条件引起的行人运动变化，同时允许不同行人的响应性存在差异。当机器人可见时，响应性会影响人群动力学，但它并不作为策略输入提供；策略必须改为从以机器人为中心的相对位置中推断其后果。一个两阶段门控Transformer逐步编码人类-人类关系和人类-机器人关系，而循环策略捕捉其时间演化。课程学习逐步降低行人响应性，以增加交互难度。仿真实验表明，在不同响应条件和人群密度下，该方法相比代表性基线提升了导航安全性和鲁棒性，并展示出无需重新训练即可迁移到结构不同的人群流布局。消融实验支持分层关系编码和门控更新。真实机器人部署进一步验证了所学策略能够在物理环境中利用稀疏观测运行。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接激光雷达-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出FAST-LIO2：一种快速、稳健且多功能的激光雷达-惯性里程计框架。FAST-LIO2建立在高效紧耦合迭代Kalman滤波器之上，具有两个关键创新，可实现快速、稳健且准确的激光雷达导航（与建图）。第一个创新是直接将原始点配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），而无需提取特征。这能够利用环境中的细微特征，从而提高精度。去除手工设计的特征提取模块也使其自然适应具有不同扫描模式的新兴激光雷达；第二个主要创新是通过增量k-d树数据结构ikd-Tree维护地图，该结构支持增量更新（即点插入、删除）和动态重平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d树）相比，ikd-Tree实现更优的整体性能，同时自然支持在树上进行降采样。我们在来自多种开放激光雷达数据集的19个序列上进行了详尽基准比较。FAST-LIO2以远低得多的计算负载，持续取得比其他最先进激光雷达-惯性导航系统更高的精度。还进行了针对小视场固态激光雷达的各种真实世界实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2计算高效（例如，在大型户外环境中最高100 Hz的里程计与建图）、稳健（例如，在旋转高达1000 deg/s的杂乱室内环境中可靠位姿估计）、多功能（即适用于多线旋转和固态激光雷达、无人机和手持平台，以及Intel和ARM处理器），同时仍比现有方法取得更高精度。我们的系统FAST-LIO2实现和数据结构ikd-Tree均在Github上开源。

items.title_en: ReVNM: Learning-Based Visual Navigation from a Remote Camera
items.title_zh: ReVNM：基于远程摄像头的学习型视觉导航
items.abstract_en: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) enable robots to navigate from egocentric visual observations without geometric localization and planning, but long-range navigation still requires pre-built maps. This paper presents the Remote Visual Navigation Model (ReVNM), which uses a single remote surveillance camera to serve as both an observation source and an implicit environmental map for visual navigation. While the use of remote cameras could eliminate the need for pre-built maps as well as onboard vision processing, their limited field of view instead of egocentric observations makes it hard to achieve collision-free navigation. The lack of existing data with diverse remote viewpoints, which are crucial for training robust VNMs, further complicates the challenge. In this work, we propose a learning-by-synthesis approach to address this two-fold challenge. Our ReVNM extends a state-of-the-art VNM architecture with an exocentric-to-egocentric (exo2ego) module that predicts an egocentric depth observation from remote-camera observations. This helps the VNM to plan a path while considering obstacles in front of the robot. Trained only on randomly generated worlds with diverse obstacle layouts and camera viewpoints, ReVNM can generalize well to real robot navigation without additional fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉导航模型（VNM）使机器人能够从自我中心视觉观测进行导航，而无需几何定位和规划，但长距离导航仍然需要预先构建的地图。本文提出远程视觉导航模型（ReVNM），使用单个远程监控相机同时作为观测源和视觉导航的隐式环境地图。虽然使用远程相机可以消除对预构建地图以及机载视觉处理的需求，但其有限的视场而非自我中心观测，使得实现无碰撞导航变得困难。现有数据缺乏多样化的远程视角，而这些视角对于训练鲁棒的VNM至关重要，这进一步增加了挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出一种合成学习方法来解决这一双重挑战。我们的ReVNM扩展了最先进的VNM架构，加入外中心到自我中心（exo2ego）模块，从远程相机观测预测自我中心深度观测。这有助于VNM在规划路径时考虑机器人前方的障碍物。ReVNM仅使用具有多样障碍物布局和相机视角的随机生成世界进行训练，无需额外微调即可很好地泛化到真实机器人导航。仿真和真实环境中的实验证实了所提方法的有效性。

items.title_en: Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control for an Omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot Using Control Barrier Function
items.title_zh: 基于控制屏障函数的全向步行辅助机器人安全约束模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Providing safe and effective mobility assistance plays a crucial role in restoring independence and enhancing the quality of life for individuals with motor impairments. In this context, robotic walking assistive devices have recently emerged as promising solutions to provide physically compliant interaction while ensuring user safety and support. This paper presents a novel control framework for an omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot (I-WANDER) that integrates a Control Barrier Function (CBF) formulation into a Model Predictive Control (MPC) scheme to explicitly enforce collision-avoidance safety constraints while optimizing for energy efficiency and smooth human-robot collaboration. The method was experimentally evaluated with 12 healthy participants performing two different walking tasks using both the proposed CBF-based MPC controller (CB-MPC) and a variable admittance controller (AC). The first task involved structured navigation through a U-shaped corridor, whereas the second consisted of a single-obstacle avoidance task performed blindfolded to ensure the obstacle was unexpected. Comparative results show that the CB-MPC architecture significantly reduces energy consumption and mechanical work (p < 0.01) without compromising motion smoothness, while also decreasing the number of obstacle collisions. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of the proposed control architecture to enhance both safety and efficiency in robotic walking assistance.
items.abstract_zh: 提供安全有效的移动辅助对于恢复运动障碍者的独立性和提高其生活质量起着关键作用。在此背景下，机器人步行辅助装置最近作为有前景的解决方案出现，可提供物理柔顺交互，同时确保用户安全与支撑。本文提出了一种用于全向步行辅助机器人（I-WANDER）的新控制框架，该框架将控制屏障函数（CBF）公式集成到模型预测控制（MPC）方案中，以显式执行避碰安全约束，同时优化能效和人机协作的平滑性。该方法通过12名健康参与者使用所提出的基于CBF的MPC控制器（CB-MPC）和可变导纳控制器（AC）执行两项不同步行任务进行了实验评估。第一项任务涉及通过U形走廊的结构化导航，第二项任务是在蒙眼条件下执行单障碍物避障任务，以确保障碍物是意外的。比较结果表明，CB-MPC架构在不损害运动平滑性的情况下显著降低能耗和机械功（p < 0.01），同时也减少了障碍物碰撞次数。总体而言，研究结果突显了所提出的控制架构在提升机器人步行辅助安全性和效率方面的潜力。

items.title_en: Evaluation of Front-End Feature Matching for Lunar Visual SLAM
items.title_zh: 月球视觉SLAM前端特征匹配评估
items.abstract_en: Lunar rovers will primarily rely on cameras for localization until navigation satellite services are deployed, and will continue to need them afterwards for relative navigation, hazard detection, and surface operations. Visual odometry (VO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) mostly estimate motion by matching features between frames. However, feature matchers are developed on urban, indoor and driving scenes, planetary studies compare them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, and real lunar imagery with reference poses is scarce, so matching between rover frames on low-texture, harshly lit terrain, and its effect on VO, has not been compared. We benchmark eleven classical and learned detector-matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a feature tracker, scoring pairwise pose accuracy against baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO. Under a common rotation-only metric, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT with ratio-tested FLANN matching on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site, with smaller or unresolved differences on synthetic data. When rotation and translation direction are scored jointly, this SIFT pairing exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, so synthetic results alone do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. In stereo VO, the SuperPoint pairings are not consistently more accurate than SIFT, but only they keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint with LightGlue is the fastest learned combination (16 ms per frame), and DINOv2 retrieval proposals still need geometric verification.
items.abstract_zh: 在导航卫星服务部署之前，月球车将主要依赖相机进行定位，之后仍将继续需要相机用于相对导航、危险检测和表面操作。视觉里程计（VO）和同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）主要通过匹配帧间特征来估计运动。然而，特征匹配器是在城市、室内和驾驶场景中开发的，行星研究在轨道配准或完整SLAM系统中对它们进行比较，而带有参考位姿的真实月球影像稀缺，因此尚未比较月球车帧间在低纹理、光照恶劣地形上的匹配及其对VO的影响。我们在九个合成、月球试验床和地球类比数据集上对十一种经典和学习的检测器-匹配器组合以及一个特征跟踪器进行基准测试，依据相对于基线的成对位姿准确性和所得VO的轨迹误差进行评分。在共同的仅旋转指标下，SuperPoint配对在两个月球试验床和一个类比站点上均优于带比率测试FLANN匹配的SIFT，在合成数据上的差异较小或未解决。当联合评分旋转和平移方向时，该SIFT配对在四个合成数据集上超过两个SuperPoint配对，因此仅凭合成结果不能确立在真实月球车影像上的相对性能。在双目VO中，SuperPoint配对并不始终比SIFT更准确，但只有它们在所有八个序列数据集上保持跟踪。与经典检测器的配对依赖光照，而SuperPoint变化很小：在同一试验床视图上，低聚光灯使其比漫射光更准确，这与更高的对比度和检测到的关键点一致。SuperPoint与LightGlue是最快的学习组合（每帧16 ms），DINOv2检索提议仍需几何验证。

items.title_en: ContextFlow: In-Context Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: ContextFlow：用于机器人操作的上下文流匹配
items.abstract_en: Although highly effective in vision and language domains, applying in-context learning to robotics remains challenging. Existing autoregressive in-context imitation methods discretize continuous actions and exacerbate the accumulation of early prediction errors through next-token prediction, limiting their generalization on unseen task configurations. Meanwhile, flow-matching policies have been explored for continuous robot control and can help mitigate compounding errors; however, in-context imitation learning within a flow-matching framework remains underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce ContextFlow, a conditional flow-matching model that learns continuous action distributions for in-context imitation learning. ContextFlow conditions flow-based action prediction on demonstrations and observations, enabling robust generation from noisy action distributions. To better encode multimodal in-context demonstrations, we adapt perceiver-style multimodal context compressors that distill visual, proprioceptive, and action sequences into compact, task-relevant latent representations. On LIBERO, ContextFlow outperforms ICRT by 35 percentage points in average success rate on unseen task configurations, while matching the performance of the task-specific fine-tuned VLA model $π_0$ without any fine-tuning on unseen tasks. On real robots, it generalizes to unseen configurations of both single-arm and bimanual tasks, achieving 40% success on a new pen-uncapping configuration. Project Page: https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管在视觉和语言领域非常有效，将上下文学习应用于机器人仍然具有挑战性。现有的自回归上下文模仿方法将连续动作离散化，并通过下一词元预测加剧早期预测误差的累积，限制了它们在未见过任务配置上的泛化。同时，流匹配策略已被探索用于连续机器人控制，并有助于缓解复合误差；然而，流匹配框架内的上下文模仿学习仍未得到充分探索。为解决这些局限，我们引入ContextFlow，一种条件流匹配模型，可为上下文模仿学习学习连续动作分布。ContextFlow以演示和观测为条件进行基于流的动作预测，从而能够从含噪动作分布中稳健生成。为更好地编码多模态上下文演示，我们采用Perceiver风格的多模态上下文压缩器，将视觉、本体感觉和动作序列提炼为紧凑的、任务相关的潜在表示。在LIBERO上，ContextFlow在未见过任务配置上的平均成功率比ICRT高35个百分点，同时在未见过任务上无需任何微调即可匹配任务特定微调的VLA模型π₀的性能。在真实机器人上，它泛化到单臂和双臂任务的未见过配置，在一个新的拔笔帽配置上达到40%的成功率。项目页面：https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/。

items.title_en: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
items.title_zh: CoopUQ：基于不确定性感知协同预测的鲁棒多机器人社会导航
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习使移动机器人能够在受限的人机共享环境中做出快速且可扩展的导航决策。然而，将单机器人方法直接扩展到多机器人场景时，往往无法确保安全性和效率，尤其是在遮挡和分布外（OOD）场景下，个体机器人可能忽视潜在风险或做出不准确的预测。如何有效利用协作来同时服务于预测和导航仍是一项重大挑战。我们提出 CoopUQ，一种多机器人社交导航框架，将不确定性感知的协同占据预测与鲁棒决策相连接。CoopUQ 通过跨机器人时空特征融合预测未来占据栅格地图，并进一步利用预测及其不确定性，通过约束多智能体强化学习引导策略，其中代价项惩罚穿越预测为被占据或高度不确定区域的导航。该设计使策略能够在分布偏移下调整其风险敏感性。在多个基于 Unity3D 的仿真环境中（包含分布内和 OOD 设置，涵盖多样布局、行人密度和匆忙行为）的实验结果表明，相较于代表性基线，预测性能与安全性均有所提升。真实机器人实验进一步证明了其在多种场景中的鲁棒性。我们的代码和视频见 https://coopuq.github.io/。

items.title_en: Robotic Boomerang Throwing via Model-Based Release Design
items.title_zh: 基于模型释放设计的机器人回旋镖投掷
items.abstract_en: Throwing objects that generate aerodynamic lift can greatly extend robot throwing beyond ballistic flight. A returning boomerang is a challenging example because its flight depends strongly on the release velocity, attitude, and spin, while robotic manipulators cannot readily reproduce the rapid motions used in human throwing. We present a model-based framework for robotic boomerang throwing centered on the release state. We identify the boomerang flight dynamics in stages to predict how flight changes across design variations. To systematically design the robot throwing motion, we screen candidate parameters according to how strongly and consistently they control release spin under uncertain contact conditions. These models are then used to design the throwing motion and boomerang for a 6-DoF manipulator with limited joint speeds. To our knowledge, this is the first robotic manipulator to generate a returning boomerang flight. In the demonstrated returning trial, the boomerang is released at 51 rad/s (8.1 rev/s), reaches 2.03 m from the robot base, and returns to touch down 0.31 m from the base. The successful release differs significantly from the measured human throws, showing that a robot need not imitate human throwing motion to achieve a returning flight. The project page is available at https://robot-boomerang.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 投掷能够产生气动升力的物体可以大大扩展机器人投掷范围，使其超越弹道飞行。回旋镖是一个具有挑战性的例子，因为其飞行强烈依赖于释放速度、姿态和旋转，而机器人机械臂不易复现人类投掷中使用的快速运动。我们提出一个以释放状态为中心的基于模型的机器人回旋镖投掷框架。我们分阶段识别回旋镖飞行动力学，以预测飞行如何随设计变化而变化。为系统设计机器人投掷运动，我们根据候选参数在不确定接触条件下控制释放旋转的强弱和一致性来筛选候选参数。随后，这些模型被用于为具有有限关节速度的6自由度机械臂设计投掷运动和回旋镖。据我们所知，这是首个产生返回回旋镖飞行的机器人机械臂。在演示的返回试验中，回旋镖以51 rad/s（8.1 rev/s）释放，到达距机器人基座2.03 m处，并返回在距基座0.31 m处触地。成功释放与测量到的人类投掷显著不同，表明机器人无需模仿人类投掷运动即可实现返回飞行。项目页面见 https://robot-boomerang.github.io

items.title_en: Online, Reachability-Aware, Sampling-Based Motion Planning
items.title_zh: 在线、可达性感知、基于采样的运动规划
items.abstract_en: Sampling-Based Model-Predictive Control (MPC) algorithms are a flexible class of controllers used for navigation on a wide range of robotic systems. Historically, such approaches have lacked hard safety guarantees, a shortcoming which we remedy in this work by computing guaranteed reachable-set overapproximations online with a fast, interval-based pipeline. We show that our method achieves similar performance to a state-of-the-art reachability-based planner without the need for the expensive pre-computation step, and can be scaled to systems that are infeasible using existing approaches. Finally, we demonstrate that our technique reduces safety violations by over 99% in a racing simulation and successfully controls a model racecar on real hardware experiments without crashes.
items.abstract_zh: 基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）算法是一类灵活的控制器，用于多种机器人系统上的导航。历史上，这类方法缺乏硬安全性保证；本工作通过一种快速的基于区间的流程在线计算有保证的可达集过近似，从而弥补这一不足。我们表明，我们的方法在无需昂贵预计算步骤的情况下，达到与最先进的基于可达性的规划器相似的性能，并且可扩展到使用现有方法不可行的系统。最后，我们证明该技术在一项竞速仿真中将安全违规减少超过 99%，并在真实硬件实验中成功控制一辆模型赛车且未发生碰撞。
items.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure

items.title_en: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
items.title_zh: Metric-Bench：探索VLM中用于室内场景的上下文空间度量推理
items.abstract_en: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards. Extensive experiments on Metric-Bench demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances spatial metric understanding, outperforming existing and even larger proprietary models by 43.1\%, while improving downstream embodied performance over a spatial-specialized counterpart by 30.4\% on RoboSpatial overall accuracy and 9.3\% on ERQA, and additionally delivering consistent gains on general benchmarks (15.9\% on V$\star$Bench, 88.9\% on BLINK), indicating that the proposed adaptation does not necessarily compromise general VLM capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 度量推理是视觉语言模型（VLM）的一项关键且具有挑战性的任务，在机器人操作和自主导航等具身AI任务中起着关键作用。然而，当前的空间推理仍受刚性像素级监督的瓶颈限制；这种局部优化常常损害通用多模态智能，引发广泛推理能力的性能下降或灾难性遗忘。为解决这些限制，我们引入Metric-Bench，一个旨在利用上下文信息引导度量空间推理的聚焦基准。通过纳入具有已知物理尺寸的图像内参考物体，Metric-Bench引导模型在无相机内参的情况下隐式学习2D到3D的映射。我们进一步提出MetricReasoner，一种用于基于参考的度量推理的任务自适应强化微调方法，使用结构化提示和可验证的数值奖励。在Metric-Bench上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著增强空间度量理解，比现有甚至更大的专有模型高出43.1%，同时在RoboSpatial总体准确率上比空间专用对应模型提升30.4%，在ERQA上提升9.3%，从而改善下游具身性能，并在通用基准上持续带来增益（V⋆Bench上15.9%，BLINK上88.9%），表明所提出的自适应并不一定损害通用VLM能力。
items.comment: Accepted to ECCV

items.title_en: Scalable, Intuitive, Mixed Reality-Based Semi-Autonomous Robotic Telemanipulation for the Execution of a Fine-Grained Bimanual Task
items.title_zh: 可扩展、直观的混合现实半自主机器人遥操作以执行细粒度双手任务
items.abstract_en: Nowadays, robotic telemanipulation enables humans to control robots so as to execute tasks in a manner similar to how they perform them, and serves as an essential approach for collecting on-robot data for robot learning by human demonstrations. The quality of collected demonstrations directly impacts the performance of the learned policy. However, existing telemanipulation systems rely heavily on human operation, particularly for large-scale data collection. Collecting dozens or hundreds of demonstrations is a demanding process, as operators tend to fatigue quickly, especially during the execution of dexterous tasks that require sustained concentration. Recently, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation has emerged as a promising direction that reduces operator workload while preserving human-in-the-loop control for task execution. We therefore introduce a scalable, intuitive, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation system that leverages a mixed reality (MR) headset for on-robot data collection. The system autonomously executes the majority of the task trajectories and only requires the operator to make fine adjustments at key stages. We validate the effectiveness of our system by collecting data and training imitation learning policies on the execution of a high-precision, fine-grained bimanual peg-in-hole task. With lower data collection effort, our system obtains high-quality demonstrations that can be used to train fully autonomous task execution policies.
items.abstract_zh: 如今，机器人遥操作使人类能够控制机器人，以类似于人类执行任务的方式执行任务，并作为通过人类演示为机器人学习收集机器人上数据的重要方法。所收集演示的质量直接影响学习策略的性能。然而，现有遥操作系统严重依赖人工操作，尤其在大规模数据收集时。收集数十或数百个演示是一个高要求过程，因为操作者容易快速疲劳，尤其是在执行需要持续集中的灵巧任务时。最近，半自主机器人遥操作已成为一个有前景的方向，可减少操作者工作负荷，同时保留任务执行中的人在环控制。因此，我们提出一种可扩展、直观的半自主机器人遥操作系统，利用混合现实（MR）头显进行机器人上数据收集。该系统自主执行大多数任务轨迹，仅要求操作者在关键阶段进行精细调整。我们通过在高精度、细粒度双臂轴孔装配任务执行中收集数据并训练模仿学习策略，验证了系统的有效性。以较低的数据收集投入，我们的系统获得高质量演示，可用于训练完全自主的任务执行策略。
items.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

items.title_en: Force-Based Offset Estimation for Keyed Peg-in-Hole Assembly Using Local Gaussian Process Regression
items.title_zh: 基于局部高斯过程回归的带键轴孔装配力觉偏移估计
items.abstract_en: Key-keyway assembly tasks impose strict geometric constraints and are highly sensitive to grasp pose deviations in uncertain environments. This work presents a force-based offset estimation method for keyed peg-in-hole assembly, embedded within a perception-validation-insertion pipeline. Residual misalignment is estimated directly from wrist force/torque measurements using a local KNN-Gaussian Process hybrid regressor. The framework distinguishes between two contact regimes, hard collision and guided chamfer insertion, and routes inference to a dedicated model for each. Regime classification is achieved via a contact-window duration threshold. KNN combined with a deterministic search using the results of a post-grasp monocular visual validation contributes to an increased accuracy of the regressor model. This approach achieves accurate radial offset estimation in chamfered peg insertion, during a keypoint detection-based pick and place application. Experiments using the integrated force/torque sensor of a collaborative robot arm showed an increase in insertion success rate from 67% to 87% after the pipeline was applied.
items.abstract_zh: 键-键槽装配任务施加严格的几何约束，并且在不确定环境中对抓取位姿偏差高度敏感。本工作提出一种用于带键轴孔装配的基于力的偏移估计方法，嵌入在感知-验证-插入流程中。残余失准直接利用腕部力/力矩测量，通过局部 KNN-高斯过程混合回归器进行估计。该框架区分两种接触状态，即硬碰撞与引导倒角插入，并将推理路由到各自专用模型。状态分类通过接触窗口持续时间阈值实现。KNN 与使用抓取后单目视觉验证结果的确定性搜索相结合，有助于提高回归器模型的精度。该方法在基于关键点检测的抓取放置应用中，于倒角轴插入期间实现了准确的径向偏移估计。使用协作机器人手臂集成力/力矩传感器的实验表明，应用该流程后插入成功率从 67% 提高到 87%。
items.comment: 6 pages, 11 figures. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM 2026), Genova, Italy. Awaiting publication in IEEE Xplore

items.title_en: NeurRAFT: Robot Motion Planning via Anchor-Level Flow Matching with Clearance-Aware Preference Tuning
items.title_zh: NeurRAFT：基于锚点级流匹配与间隙感知偏好调优的机器人运动规划
items.abstract_en: Recent end-to-end neural motion planners generate trajectories from raw sensor observations, avoiding the privileged geometric models required by classical planners. However, collision-free planning in cluttered environments remains challenging. We present NeurRAFT, a generative planning framework based on anchor-level flow matching and clearance-aware preference tuning. Unlike prior neural planners that model dense waypoint sequences and spend capacity on redundant local details and smoothness, NeurRAFT operates on compact anchor waypoints. We train the planner using a Jacobian-weighted loss that accounts for the task-space impact of each anchor. At inference, the anchors are generated in two integration steps, followed by cubic-spline interpolation to recover a smooth, full-resolution trajectory. Since imitation learning from positive demonstrations cannot distinguish collision-free from near-collision trajectories, collision-prone behaviors persist at test time. Rather than relying on post-hoc corrections, we directly reshape the pretrained planner's distribution toward safer solutions without augmenting inference. Specifically, Direct Preference Optimization shifts probability mass toward trajectories with larger obstacle clearance, with the resulting improvement directly absorbed into the planner parameters. Experiments show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art planners, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer to a Franka robot under noisy and partially occluded depth observations. Video results available at https://neurraft.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 最近的端到端神经运动规划器从原始传感器观测生成轨迹，避免了经典规划器所需的特权几何模型。然而，在杂乱环境中的无碰撞规划仍然具有挑战性。我们提出NeurRAFT，一个基于锚点级流匹配和间隙感知偏好调优的生成式规划框架。与先前对稠密路点序列建模并将容量花费在冗余局部细节和平滑性上的神经规划器不同，NeurRAFT在紧凑的锚点路点上运行。我们使用考虑每个锚点任务空间影响的雅可比加权损失来训练规划器。在推理时，通过两个积分步骤生成锚点，随后进行三次样条插值以恢复平滑的全分辨率轨迹。由于从正演示进行模仿学习无法区分无碰撞轨迹和接近碰撞轨迹，测试时仍会持续出现易碰撞行为。我们不依赖事后修正，而是直接将预训练规划器的分布重塑向更安全的解决方案，而不增强推理。具体而言，直接偏好优化将概率质量转向具有更大障碍物间隙的轨迹，由此产生的改进直接吸收到规划器参数中。实验显示相对于最先进规划器有显著改进，同时真实世界实验证明在噪声和部分遮挡深度观测下可零样本迁移到Franka机器人。视频结果见 https://neurraft.github.io/。

items.title_en: BRAVE-6D: Benchmark for Robotic Active Vision in 6DOF Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: BRAVE-6D：面向6DOF位姿估计的机器人主动视觉基准
items.abstract_en: Detecting and grasping small objects remains a significant challenge in robotics. Active vision, where the robot moves closer to the object, is an intuitive solution, yet comparing approaches on common ground is difficult since identical physical scene setups are required. Hence, we introduce BRAVE-6D, a benchmark designed to evaluate robotic active vision systems for object pose estimation, a crucial first step in grasping objects. BRAVE-6D leverages view synthesis based on Gaussian Splats (3DGS) to provide scenes and tools for benchmarking active vision systems. We show baseline solutions performing visual servoing within the scene and accurately estimating the poses of small objects.
items.abstract_zh: 检测和抓取小物体仍然是机器人学中的重大挑战。主动视觉——即机器人移近物体——是一种直观的解决方案，但由于需要相同的物理场景设置，在共同基础上比较不同方法很困难。因此，我们提出BRAVE-6D，一个旨在评估用于物体位姿估计的机器人主动视觉系统的基准，物体位姿估计是抓取物体的关键第一步。BRAVE-6D利用基于高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splats, 3DGS）的视图合成，为主动视觉系统的基准测试提供场景和工具。我们展示了在场景内执行视觉伺服并准确估计小物体位姿的基线解决方案。
items.comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Extended abstract presented at ICRA@40, Rotterdam, The Netherlands, September 2024

items.title_en: Augmented Reality Interfaces for Human-Robot Collaboration: Development of a ROS 2-Based Sensor Streaming Framework and Validation via SLAM Algorithms
items.title_zh: 面向人机协作的增强现实接口：基于ROS 2的传感器流传输框架开发及通过SLAM算法的验证
items.abstract_en: In recent years, Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) has taken on a central role in Industry 4.0 and collaborative robotics, demanding communication channels that are increasingly bidirectional, intuitive, and efficient. In this context, Augmented Reality (AR) presents itself as a fundamental enabling technology, capable of both displaying information to the operator and gathering spatial data about the surrounding environment. This thesis presents the development of a sensor streaming framework that connects the Magic Leap 2 AR headset with the ROS 2 (Robot Operating System) ecosystem. Using the Unity development environment and the ROSTCP-Connector package, an on-board application for the headset was developed, capable of acquiring real-time data from the integrated sensors (pose tracking, cameras, and environmental sensors) and publishing it to dedicated ROS 2 topics. In order to test the accuracy, latency, and robustness of the generated data stream, the framework was validated using SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithms known in the literature. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed architecture ensures stable data transmission, laying the groundwork for safe real-time interaction and shared spatial awareness, and opening up new perspectives for the control and supervision of robotic systems in complex HRC scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，人机协作（HRC）在工业4.0和协作机器人中占据核心地位，要求通信通道日益双向、直观且高效。在此背景下，增强现实（AR）成为一种基础性使能技术，既能够向操作员显示信息，也能够采集有关周围环境的空间数据。本论文介绍了一个传感器流传输框架的开发，该框架将Magic Leap 2 AR头显与ROS 2（机器人操作系统）生态系统连接起来。使用Unity开发环境和ROSTCP-Connector包，为头显开发了一个板载应用，能够从集成传感器（位姿跟踪、相机和环境传感器）获取实时数据，并将其发布到专用的ROS 2话题。为了测试所生成数据流的准确性、延迟和鲁棒性，使用文献中已知的SLAM（同步定位与建图）算法对该框架进行了验证。实验结果表明，所提出的架构确保了稳定的数据传输，为安全的实时交互和共享空间感知奠定了基础，并为复杂HRC场景中机器人系统的控制与监督开辟了新视角。
items.comment: Bachelor's Thesis, University of Padua (IAS-Lab). 92 pages, 31 figures

items.title_en: PVRA: A Pointwise Key-point Voting Framework for Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: PVRA：一种用于机器人装配的逐点关键点投票框架
items.abstract_en: Modern computer vision has enabled partial autonomy in robotic assembly manipulation. However, performing autonomous manipulation of a progressive assembly demands a more specific set of skills, in addition to perceiving the objects. Through a comparative analysis of research in the associated domains, we deduce that object-centric perception must advance towards learning assembly dependencies to predict meaningful actionable outputs for autonomous assembly manipulation. Subsequently, we present a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework to learn assembly dependencies to infer actionable outputs given a RGB-D input of an assembly scene. We train and evaluate our trained network on an assembly pose estimation dataset and compare it against object-centric baselines with an augmented set of metrics for progressive assemblies.
items.abstract_zh: 现代计算机视觉已在机器人装配操作中实现了部分自主。然而，对渐进式装配执行自主操作，除了感知物体之外，还需要一组更特定的技能。通过对相关领域研究的比较分析，我们推断，以物体为中心的感知必须向学习装配依赖关系推进，以预测用于自主装配操作的有意义的可操作输出。随后，我们提出了一个基于3D关键点的模块化学习框架，用于学习装配依赖关系，从而在给定装配场景的RGB-D输入时推断可操作输出。我们在一个装配位姿估计数据集上训练并评估了训练后的网络，并使用针对渐进式装配扩充的指标集，将其与以物体为中心的基线进行比较。
items.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for presentation at the European Conference on Robotics (ECoR) 2026

items.title_en: Spatial-Semantic Reasoning using Large Language Models for Efficient UAV Search Operations
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型进行高效无人机搜索操作的空间语义推理
items.abstract_en: We present a real-time semantic navigation framework for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) focused on improving time efficiency in the Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) task. Central to our approach is a Large Language Model (LLM) that interprets user-provided natural language instructions and performs semantic reasoning over detected objects and spatial context to prioritize high-probability search regions. The system combines real-time object detection, 3D spatial mapping, and polynomial spline interpolation for smooth and feasible UAV trajectory planning. Unlike prior methods that rely on offline reasoning or simulator-constrained action spaces, our framework can operate in real time, continuously updating semantic relevance based on new observations. Experiments in both simulated and real-world settings demonstrate reductions in mission duration while maintaining high search accuracy, underscoring the effectiveness of LLM-guided reasoning for time- efficient UAV-based ObjectNav.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种面向无人机（UAV）的实时语义导航框架，重点提高物体目标导航（ObjectNav）任务中的时间效率。我们方法的核心是一个大语言模型（LLM），它解释用户提供的自然语言指令，并对检测到的物体和空间上下文执行语义推理，以优先考虑高概率搜索区域。该系统结合了实时物体检测、3D空间建图以及多项式样条插值，用于平滑且可行的无人机轨迹规划。与依赖离线推理或模拟器约束动作空间的先前方法不同，我们的框架可以实时运行，根据新观测持续更新语义相关性。在仿真和真实环境中的实验表明，任务持续时间缩短，同时保持高搜索准确率，凸显了LLM引导推理在时间高效的基于无人机ObjectNav中的有效性。

items.title_en: RoughSense: Lightweight Terrain-Induced Rover Vibration Prediction Using Point Clouds and IMU Feedback
items.title_zh: RoughSense：使用点云和IMU反馈的轻量级地形诱导巡视器振动预测
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in space requires reliable terrain assessment for safe operations, especially in underground environments with limited communication, computing resources, and power budget. This paper presents a lightweight method for real-time vibration-aware traversability mapping using a Light Detecting And Ranging (LiDAR) point cloud and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements. An initial vibration proxy is estimated from terrain geometry by applying Random sample consensus (RANSAC) to local point-cloud patches produced by a Simultaneous Localisation And Mapping (SLAM) algorithm. In parallel, the IMU provides local observations of the vibration experienced by the rover during traversal. The point-cloud-based prediction is then corrected online using Recursive Least Squares, allowing the system to adapt the geometric estimate to the measured rover response. The approach is evaluated in a lunar analogue environment, an outdoor field, and an underground mine.
items.abstract_zh: 太空中的自主导航需要可靠的地形评估以保障安全运行，尤其是在通信、计算资源和功率预算有限的地下环境中。本文提出了一种轻量级方法，利用激光探测与测距（LiDAR）点云和惯性测量单元（IMU）测量，进行实时振动感知的可通行性建图。通过将随机采样一致性（RANSAC）应用于同步定位与建图（SLAM）算法生成的局部点云块，从地形几何中估计初始振动代理量。同时，IMU提供巡视器在穿越过程中所经历振动的局部观测。随后，使用递归最小二乘法在线校正基于点云的预测，使系统能够根据测得的巡视器响应调整几何估计。该方法在月球模拟环境、室外场地和地下矿井中进行了评估。

items.title_en: ECO-COMM: An Ultra Low-Latency Event Camera based Optical Communication System
items.abstract_en: Ultralow-latency communication is critical for emerging next-generation applications such as XR, real-time control, and distributed sensing. We present ECO-COMM, an event-camera-based optical communication system for ultra-low-latency device association and lightweight information exchange. By exploiting the asynchronous sensing and microsecond-level temporal resolution of event cameras, ECO-COMM captures high-frequency optical signals without frame-based acquisition delays. We identify and analyze key hardware-induced challenges in event-camera communication, including timestamp inconsistency, readout contention, trailing effects, and the inevitable refractory period, and develop hardware-aware mitigation techniques to address them. Focusing on a single transmitter-receiver optical link, ECO-COMM establishes the feasibility of practical ultra-low-latency event-camera communication using commercially available hardware.A prototype implementation using an eight-LED transmitter and an off-the-shelf event camera achieves device association within 15 microseconds, symbol latency as low as 100 microseconds, and end-to-end latency below 8 milliseconds for 32-byte payloads at 0.1% bit error rate. ECO-COMM establishes a practical and complementary communication paradigm for ultra-low-latency systems where responsiveness and temporal precision are paramount.
items.title_zh: ECO-COMM：一种基于事件相机的超低时延光通信系统
items.abstract_zh: 超低时延通信对XR、实时控制和分布式感知等新兴下一代应用至关重要。我们提出ECO-COMM，一种基于事件相机的光通信系统，用于超低时延的设备关联与轻量信息交换。利用事件相机的异步感知与微秒级时间分辨率，ECO-COMM无需基于帧的采集延迟即可捕获高频光信号。我们识别并分析了事件相机通信中若干关键的硬件诱发挑战，包括时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应以及不可避免的不应期，并开发了硬件感知的缓解技术予以应对。聚焦单个发射机—接收机光链路，ECO-COMM验证了使用商用现成硬件实现实用超低时延事件相机通信的可行性。基于八个LED发射机与商用事件相机的原型实现，可在15微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至100微秒，并在0.1%误码率下实现32字节载荷低于8毫秒的端到端时延。ECO-COMM为以响应性和时间精度为优先的超低时延系统建立了一种实用且互补的通信范式。
items.highlight_zh: 用事件相机实现15微秒设备关联的超低时延光通信
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：XR、实时控制、分布式感知等应用对通信时延极其敏感，传统相机以固定帧率采集，天然带来帧周期等待，难以支撑微秒级的设备发现与轻量数据交换。

方法思路：作者提出 ECO-COMM，改用事件相机作为光接收端。事件相机不是逐帧曝光，而是每个像素在亮度变化时异步输出事件，因此具备微秒级时间分辨率，能直接捕捉高速闪烁的光信号，避免帧采集延迟。团队还系统梳理了这类方案中由硬件引入的四类难题：时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应与不应期，并针对性地设计了硬件感知的补偿与调度技术。

实验结果：在单发射机—单接收机的链路原型上，使用八个 LED 组成的发射端与商用事件相机，系统可在 15 微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至 100 微秒；传输 32 字节载荷时，在 0.1% 误码率下端到端时延低于 8 毫秒。

为何重要：该工作证明仅用市面可得的硬件就能实现实用的超低时延光通信，并给出了一条与射频方案互补的技术路线。其价值在于把“感知式接收”引入通信领域，为对响应速度与时间精度要求极高的系统提供了新的设计范式，同时也为后续多链路、更高吞吐的研究标出了硬件瓶颈。

items.title_en: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
items.title_zh: EmbodiedLab：评测“以行动求认知”的具身智能体基准
items.abstract_en: Embodied agents are expected to accomplish real-world goals by deciding for themselves how and when to interact with their surroundings. For many such goals, changing the physical state of the world is the means rather than the end: the agent changes the state of a system through interaction, observes the feedback, and explores until it either achieves the goal itself (e.g., discovering physical laws) or learns what the goal requires; it acts to know. Manipulation benchmarks stop at acting to change, with the target state given; scientific discovery benchmarks evaluate knowing but replace physical experimentation with symbolic actions or numerical queries. We introduce EmbodiedLab, a benchmark in which a robot must act to know. Quantitative science experiments make this setting controllable: the parameters of the system are resampled for every instance, so the result cannot be known in advance, yet it can be scored exactly. Across 30 experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms, the agent receives an objective and the apparatus, chooses its own procedure, and operates a physics-based simulated laboratory, reading the instruments through its cameras. Evaluation checks what the agent came to know, grounded in readings recorded during the episode, as well as the physical state the task requires; every experiment is verified to be solvable. We evaluate six frontier models in their developers' coding agents with native observation and control, with added perception and motion planning, and with manipulation skills distilled from the strongest agents. With native control, even the strongest agent succeeds less than half the time; for every agent, most failures arise in interacting with the apparatus, and manipulation skills help weaker agents more than perception and planning. The benchmark and its evaluation code are available at https://github.com/HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab.
items.abstract_zh: 具身智能体应能自主决定何时、如何与环境交互来完成真实目标。对许多目标而言，改变世界状态只是手段而非目的：智能体通过交互改变系统状态、观察反馈、不断探索，直到达成目标（例如发现物理规律）或弄清目标所需条件，即“以行动求知”。现有操作类基准止步于“以行动改变”，且目标状态已给定；科学发现类基准则评测“知”，却用符号动作或数值查询替代真实物理实验。作者提出 EmbodiedLab：机器人在其中必须靠行动获知。定量科学实验使这一设定可控——每个实例的系统参数都会重新采样，结果无法预先得知，却能精确评分。基准涵盖 5 个学科、14 种实验装置平台上的 30 个实验，智能体获得目标与装置后自行决定流程，在基于物理的仿真实验室中操作，并通过相机读取仪器。评测既检查智能体最终“知道了什么”（以其在回合中记录到的读数作为依据），也检查任务要求的物理状态；每个实验均经验证可解。作者在开发者提供的编程智能体中评测六个前沿模型，分别采用原生观测与控制、增加感知与运动规划、以及从最强智能体蒸馏出的操作技能三种配置。原生控制下即使最强智能体成功率也不足一半；对每个智能体，多数失败发生在与装置交互环节，且操作技能对较弱智能体的帮助大于感知增强。
items.highlight_zh: 首个要求机器人通过物理实验主动“求知”并可精确评分的基准
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：现在的机器人基准大致分两类。一类是操作任务，比如“把杯子放到架子上”——目标状态已经告诉你了，机器人只需动手；另一类是科学发现任务，评测的是“知不知道某个规律”，但往往用符号动作或数值查询代替真实实验。中间那种更真实的能力被忽略了：机器人需要通过动手改变系统、观察反馈、反复试探，才能搞清楚系统是怎么运作的——即“以行动求知”（act to know）。

方法与数据：作者构建了 EmbodiedLab。之所以选定量科学实验，是因为它既可控又可精确评分：每个实例的系统参数（如质量、摩擦、电路参数）都会重新随机采样，因此结果不可能提前背下来，但最终答案能严格判分。基准包含 5 个学科、14 种实验装置平台上的 30 个实验。智能体拿到任务目标和实验装置后，自己决定实验流程，在基于物理的仿真实验室里操作设备，并通过自身相机读取仪器示数。

评测方式：评分有两个维度——一是“它学到了什么”，依据是回合中实际记录到的仪器读数，防止它靠猜；二是任务要求的最终物理状态是否达成。所有实验都经过验证确保可解。

实验结果：作者在开发者自带的编程智能体框架中评测了 6 个前沿模型，设置三种条件：原生观测与控制、额外加入感知与运动规划模块、以及从最强智能体蒸馏得到的操作技能。结果显示：即便最强模型在原生的控制条件下成功率也不到一半；对所有智能体而言，失败大多发生在“与仪器交互”这一步，而不是推理；操作技能对弱模型的提升明显大于加感知模块带来的提升。

为何重要：它把“具身智能”的评测从“会不会动手完成任务”推进到“会不会动手搞明白事情”，并且用可精确判分的物理实验提供了严谨标尺。结论也给出明确方向：当前瓶颈不在高层推理，而在可靠地操作实验装置。

items.title_en: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
items.title_zh: BeeWhere：分割熊蜂群落以量化行为影响
items.abstract_en: Social bees are important pollinators that support biodiversity and crop pollination globally and serve as important model systems for collective behavior, but scalable measurement of individual- and colony-level behavior remains difficult in dense, occluded nest environments. Existing monitoring workflows use fiducial tags (e.g., ArUco) to preserve individual identity, yet tag-based tracking can fail when markers are obscured and provide limited information about body extent, spatial context, and untagged individuals. We present BeeWhere, an AI-assisted annotation and analysis workflow that combines ArUco detections with deep-learnt instance segmentations to quantify bumble bee behavior from high-resolution colony images and videos. Using bumble bee (Bombus impatiens) microcolonies as a test case, we annotate 483 frames containing 8,443 bee instances. We additionally annotate pollen balls, nest structures, and chamber boundaries, and train YOLO instance segmentation models for downstream behavioral analysis. Instance segmentations enable quantification of important behavioral metrics based on body contours, including nearest-neighbor distance, proximity to nest structures, spatial occupancy within the nest, and detection counts over time. We apply the BeeWhere models to tag-based tracking in an exploratory validation study assessing the behavioral impacts of neonicotinoid pesticide exposure. BeeWhere increased detection rates compared to tag-based tracking, particularly when bees were partially obscured or under challenging imaging conditions, and also captured treatment-associated changes in bee spatial organization not captured using tag-based tracking alone. These results suggest that instance segmentation can complement fiducial-marker tracking by recovering behaviorally meaningful signals under challenging colony conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 社会性蜜蜂是全球生物多样性和作物授粉的重要支撑，也是研究集体行为的重要模式系统，但在密集、遮挡严重的巢穴环境中，对个体和群体行为的可扩展测量仍然困难。现有监测流程使用基准标记（如 ArUco）来保持个体身份，但当标记被遮挡时追踪会失败，且对体表范围、空间语境和未标记个体提供的信息有限。本文提出 BeeWhere，一种 AI 辅助的标注与分析流程，将 ArUco 检测与深度学习实例分割相结合，从高分辨率蜂群图像和视频中量化熊蜂行为。以 Bombus impatiens 微型蜂群为测试案例，我们标注了 483 帧、共 8,443 个蜜蜂实例，并额外标注花粉球、巢结构与巢室边界，训练 YOLO 实例分割模型用于下游行为分析。实例分割支持基于身体轮廓量化关键行为指标，包括最近邻距离、与巢结构的邻近度、巢内空间占据以及随时间变化的检测计数。我们将模型用于基于标记的追踪，在一项探索性验证研究中评估新烟碱类农药暴露的行为影响。相比标记追踪，BeeWhere 提高了检测率，尤其在蜜蜂被部分遮挡或成像条件困难时，并捕捉到标记追踪未能发现的与处理相关的蜜蜂空间组织变化。这些结果表明，实例分割可以补充基准标记追踪，恢复更多行为信息。
items.highlight_zh: 融合 ArUco 与实例分割，突破遮挡下的熊蜂行为量化难题
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究的问题：社会性蜜蜂（如熊蜂）是重要的授粉者和研究群体行为的模式生物，但想测量每只蜂和整群蜂在做什么非常难——蜂巢里蜂挤在一起、互相遮挡，传统用 ArUco 等基准标记贴标签追踪的方法，一旦标记被挡住就失效，而且标记只能给出一个点，无法说明蜂的身体范围和周围空间关系，对没贴标签的蜂更是无能为力。

2. 方法：作者提出 BeeWhere，一个结合 AI 标注与分析的工作流程。它把 ArUco 标记检测（保证身份）与深度学习实例分割（给出每只蜂的完整轮廓）结合起来，从高分辨率蜂巢图像和视频中提取行为信息。研究以 Bombus impatiens 微型蜂群为对象，人工标注了 483 帧、共 8,443 个蜜蜂实例，还标注了花粉球、巢结构和巢室边界，并训练 YOLO 实例分割模型供下游分析使用。

3. 结果：有了身体轮廓，就能算出多种行为指标，例如最近邻距离、与巢结构的邻近程度、在巢内的空间占位，以及随时间变化的检测数量。作者把模型接到基于标记的追踪流程里，做了一项探索性验证：考察新烟碱类农药暴露对行为的影响。结果显示 BeeWhere 的检测率高于纯标记追踪，尤其在蜂被部分遮挡或成像条件差时；它还捕捉到与农药处理相关的蜜蜂空间组织变化，而这些变化单靠标记追踪看不出来。

4. 为何重要：这项工作说明实例分割可以补上标记追踪的短板——不仅能找回被遮挡的个体，还能把「蜂在空间里怎么分布、怎么聚集」这类群体层面的信息变成可量化的数据。这为大规模、自动化的蜂群行为监测和农药等环境压力评估提供了更可靠的工具，也为其他密集群居昆虫的行为研究提供了可复用的思路。

items.title_en: SNAP: Semantic Navigation Among Pedestrians
items.title_zh: SNAP：行人间的语义导航
items.abstract_en: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policy that jointly reasons about semantic terrain and dynamic obstacles from a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map, without relying on explicit human-state estimation. Our policy outperforms established crowd-navigation and semantic-aware baselines and transfers zero-shot to a legged robot, demonstrating socially compliant navigation in highly dynamic real-world scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 在拥挤的城市环境中导航要求机器人避开行人，同时遵守诸如保持在人行道上等社会规范。现有方法通常孤立地处理人群避让或语义路径规划。我们提出了一种强化学习（RL）导航策略，从单个语义标注的鸟瞰图（BEV）地图中联合推理语义地形和动态障碍物，而不依赖显式的人类状态估计。我们的策略优于已有的人群导航和语义感知基线，并零样本迁移到足式机器人，展示了在高动态真实场景中符合社会规范的导航。

items.title_en: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
items.title_zh: VIP：基于变分的迭代学习机器人导航规划
items.abstract_en: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.
items.abstract_zh: 过去十年中，自主机器人系统越来越多地部署于测绘、搜索救援和最后一英里配送等应用。这些应用要求机器人在大型、复杂且障碍物密集的环境中生成安全高效的运动规划，且通常机载计算资源有限。然而，传统规划方法通常依赖有限维轨迹参数化或越来越长的预测时域，导致计算成本迅速增长，尤其是在多机器人场景中。本文提出一种新颖的基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，用于单个机器人和机器人集群的高效运动规划。VIP 不优化大量离散轨迹变量，而是将规划指令作为无限维函数空间中的连续函数直接更新。相同的基于变分的更新可以以模型在环方式实现用于离线规划，或以机器人在环方式在在线物理执行之间实现。通过避免与时域扩展和高维轨迹离散化相关的计算负担，VIP 保持每次迭代的计算复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(n)$，其中 $n$ 表示空间离散点的数量。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，所提出的框架能够针对不同规划目标、机器人平台和集群配置高效生成并迭代改进运动规划，突显了其作为一种通用规划方法的有效性、计算效率和可扩展性。

items.title_en: Risk-Aware Kinodynamic Motion Planning Under Uncertainty For Safe Navigation on Planetary Environments
items.title_zh: 面向行星环境安全导航的不确定性下风险感知运动动力学规划
items.abstract_en: For autonomous space exploration, robotic agents need to perform motion planning in which environmental interactions may be unknown. Learning these interactions, such as terrain mechanics for wheeled robots, can introduce uncertainties that lead to risky motion plans and potentially hazardous operations or mission failures. Moreover, uncertainties induced by perception-based systems can exacerbate the problem of safe motion planning. In this letter, we address the problem of performing cost-optimal kinodynamic motion planning with risk awareness. We approach this in two steps. First, a sampling-based planner (AO-RRT) generates a dynamically feasible, risk-aware, and asymptotically cost-optimal trajectory. Second, we formulate motion planning as a nonlinear optimization problem and solve it using sequential convex programming (SCP), using the AO-RRT trajectory as an initial solution. By quantifying risk using conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), we demonstrate a reduction in risk by over $\sim$97\% across trajectories in simulation and hardware experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 对于自主太空探索，机器人智能体需要执行环境交互可能未知的运动规划。学习这些交互（例如轮式机器人的地形力学）会引入不确定性，从而导致有风险的运动规划以及可能危险的操作或任务失败。此外，基于感知的系统所引起的不确定性会加剧安全运动规划问题。本文解决具有风险意识的代价最优运动动力学规划问题。我们分两步处理。首先，基于采样的规划器（AO-RRT）生成动态可行、风险感知且渐近代价最优的轨迹。其次，我们将运动规划表述为非线性优化问题，并使用序列凸规划（SCP）求解，将 AO-RRT 轨迹作为初始解。通过使用条件风险价值（CVaR）量化风险，我们证明在仿真和硬件实验中轨迹的风险降低超过约97%。

items.title_en: Graph-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Systems with Time-Varying Topology
items.title_zh: 面向时变拓扑多智能体系统的基于图的安全强化学习
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a graph-based safe multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for cooperative navigation with time-varying topology. To address the critical challenge of ensuring safety in environments with sensing constraints, a safety-decoupled mechanism is introduced through a Control Barrier-Like Function (CBLF) action screening layer. This mechanism bridges the gap between discrete LiDAR perception and continuous safety constraints, ensuring that physical safety constraints are strictly satisfied regardless of the learning progress. Building upon this safety foundation, a unified structural architecture is proposed, integrating a attention-based actor and a Graph Attention Network (GAT) centralized critic. The actor utilizes a value vector reconstruction mechanism that explicitly encodes relative geometric relations through a collaborative tracking error matrix, enabling scale-insensitive policy learning under time-varying communication topologies. Meanwhile, the GAT-based critic models evolving interaction structures for accurate global value estimation. The proposed framework is validated on real differential-drive robot platforms, and experimental results demonstrate superior stability and safety in dynamic scenarios with limited fields-of-view.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于图的时变拓扑多智能体安全强化学习（MARL）框架，用于协同导航。为应对在感知受限环境中确保安全的关键挑战，通过类控制屏障函数（CBLF）动作筛选层引入安全解耦机制。该机制弥合离散LiDAR感知与连续安全约束之间的差距，确保无论学习进展如何都严格满足物理安全约束。在此安全基础上，提出一种统一结构架构，集成基于注意力的actor与图注意力网络（GAT）集中式critic。actor采用值向量重构机制，通过协同跟踪误差矩阵显式编码相对几何关系，从而在时变通信拓扑下实现尺度不敏感的策略学习。同时，基于GAT的critic对演化交互结构建模以进行准确的全局价值估计。所提框架在真实差速驱动机器人平台上验证，实验结果表明在有限视野的动态场景中具有更优的稳定性和安全性。

items.title_en: Macro-Action Topological Navigation under Noisy Localization using Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的噪声定位下的宏动作拓扑导航
items.abstract_en: Navigating large, photorealistic 3D apartments from raw pixels is widely considered infeasible for plain reinforcement learning. We build an agent that does it anyway, estimating its own pose from the camera alone. The agent has to reach several target objects in sequence, and their positions change between episodes, so it must explore to find them. It builds on our earlier object-centric topological controller, which still read the agent's true pose and its object detections from the simulator. Here we replace that true pose with an onboard, object-centric estimate. For each object we keep a bank of ORB features that, when the object is seen again, yield a rough pose measurement, which a minimal Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fuses with a motion model. As on a real robot, the executed motions are noisy. The estimate drifts, but the agent and the nearby objects drift together, so a locally consistent pose is enough to follow each short edge and then home in visually on the target, which lets us replace full SLAM with a much smaller model, closer to how biological navigation appears to work. In the photorealistic Habitat simulator, the agent reaches its target objects from vision alone, with a pose that only needs to be locally consistent.
items.abstract_zh: 仅从原始像素导航大型逼真3D公寓，通常被认为对普通强化学习不可行。我们构建了一个仍然能做到这一点的智能体，它仅从相机估计自身位姿。该智能体必须按顺序到达多个目标物体，而这些物体的位置在回合之间会变化，因此它必须探索以找到它们。它建立在我们先前的以物体为中心的拓扑控制器之上，该控制器仍从仿真器读取智能体的真实位姿及其物体检测结果。在这里，我们用机载的、以物体为中心的估计替代真实位姿。对于每个物体，我们维护一个ORB特征库；当再次看到该物体时，该特征库可给出粗略的位姿测量，再由一个最小扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）与运动模型融合。与真实机器人一样，执行的运动带有噪声。估计会漂移，但智能体和附近物体会一起漂移，因此局部一致的位姿足以沿每条短边行进，然后通过视觉锁定目标，这使我们能够用一个小得多的模型替代完整SLAM，更接近生物导航似乎的工作方式。在逼真的Habitat仿真器中，智能体仅依靠视觉到达目标物体，其位姿只需局部一致。

items.title_en: Generalizable 6D Pose Estimation of Textureless Objects with Planar-based Gaussian Splatting
items.title_zh: 基于平面高斯泼溅的无纹理物体可泛化6D位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Estimating the 6D pose of textureless objects without prior CAD models remains a critical challenge due to the lack of appearance features. While recent generalizable approaches alleviate the dependence on object-specific models, their performance on low-texture objects is often limited by insufficient geometric constraints in the underlying representations. In this work, we propose PG-Pose, a geometry-aware framework combining Planar-based Gaussian Splatting (PGS) reconstruction and Geometry-driven pose optimization. In the offline representation extraction stage, three distinct representations of the object are extracted from multi-view reference RGB images with known poses. PG-Pose reconstructs a 3D Gaussian representation and renders high-fidelity depth maps to generate 3D point clouds through back projection. In the online pose inference stage, the initial pose of the input image is estimated by 2D-3D correspondence matching between the input image and the reconstructed 3D point clouds, followed by a PGS-Refiner for iterative pose optimization. Evaluations on the OnePose-LowTexture datasets, PG-Pose achieves an average accuracy of 94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d, with a 2.1% improvement average accuracy compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) GS-based approach. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of PG-Pose for industrial robots in grasping tasks, we deploy it on a dual-arm industrial robot and successfully realize the grasping task on an unseen object.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有先验CAD模型的情况下估计无纹理物体的6D位姿仍然是一项关键挑战，因为缺乏外观特征。尽管近期可泛化方法减轻了对特定物体模型的依赖，但其在低纹理物体上的性能往往受限于底层表示中几何约束不足。在这项工作中，我们提出PG-Pose，一个几何感知框架，结合基于平面的高斯泼溅（PGS）重建与几何驱动的位姿优化。在离线表示提取阶段，从具有已知位姿的多视角参考RGB图像中提取物体的三种不同表示。PG-Pose重建3D高斯表示并渲染高保真深度图，通过反投影生成3D点云。在在线位姿推理阶段，通过输入图像与重建3D点云之间的2D-3D对应匹配估计输入图像的初始位姿，随后由PGS-Refiner进行迭代位姿优化。在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上的评估中，PG-Pose达到94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d的平均准确率，相比最先进的（SOTA）基于GS的方法平均准确率提升2.1%。为进一步证明PG-Pose在工业机器人抓取任务中的有效性，我们将其部署到双臂工业机器人上，并成功实现对未见物体的抓取任务。

items.title_en: Motion-as-Prompt: Enhancing Motion Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Motion-Guided Cross-Frame Visual Prompting
items.title_zh: Motion-as-Prompt：通过运动引导的跨帧视觉提示增强多模态大语言模型中的运动推理
items.abstract_en: Motion-centric video reasoning is fundamental to interactive applications such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically process videos through sparse uniform sampling to control visual-token and attention costs. This strategy may discard critical transitions between sampled frames, limiting reasoning about object movement, collisions, and causal interactions. To mitigate this issue, we propose Motion-as-Prompt (MaP), a track-guided cross-frame visual prompting framework. MaP recovers dense point trajectories, selects motion-informative frames, and marks the trajectories accumulated between consecutive sampled frames directly onto the visual inputs, making otherwise hidden displacement, direction changes, and interactions observable to frozen MLLMs. Experiments on CLEVRER and Something-Something-v2 show that MaP consistently improves average motion-reasoning accuracy, yielding gains of 4.2% and 8.9% for GPT-5.5, respectively. Notably, these improvements are obtained without degrading non-motion understanding, highlighting the robustness of MaP. These results demonstrate that MaP provides a simple and effective solution for enhancing motion-centric video reasoning without model training or architectural modification. Project page:https://github.com/SunVictor23/MaP.
items.abstract_zh: 以运动为中心的视频推理是机器人操作和自主导航等交互应用的基础。然而，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通常通过稀疏均匀采样处理视频，以控制视觉token和注意力开销。这种策略可能丢弃采样帧之间的关键过渡，限制对物体运动、碰撞和因果交互的推理。为缓解该问题，我们提出Motion-as-Prompt（MaP），一种轨迹引导的跨帧视觉提示框架。MaP恢复稠密点轨迹，选择运动信息丰富的帧，并将连续采样帧之间累积的轨迹直接标记到视觉输入上，使原本隐藏的位移、方向变化和交互对冻结的MLLM可观察。在CLEVRER和Something-Something-v2上的实验表明，MaP持续提升平均运动推理准确率，分别使GPT-5.5获得4.2%和8.9%的提升。值得注意的是，这些改进是在不降低非运动理解的情况下获得的，凸显了MaP的鲁棒性。这些结果表明，MaP为增强以运动为中心的视频推理提供了一种简单有效的解决方案，无需模型训练或架构修改。项目页面：https://github.com/SunVictor23/MaP。

items.title_en: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: F2G-Pose：面向直接RGB-D类别级物体位姿估计的几何感知基础特征提升
items.abstract_en: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究类别级 RGB-D 物体位姿估计，即在没有实例专用 CAD 模型或参考视图的情况下恢复物体的三维旋转与平移。类内差异、对称性与部分观测使该任务高度歧义。现有方法难以兼顾可靠性与效率：基于中间结构的方法易误差传播，扩散模型推理延迟高且候选提取复杂。为此，作者提出 F2G-Pose——一个实时、直接、单次前向的框架，可从单帧 RGB-D 观测一次性预测类别级位姿、度量尺寸与相机坐标系下的补全形状。方法将稠密视觉基础特征提升到部分点云，用 DGCNN 做局部几何 token 化，并以 Mixture-of-Experts Transformer 融合物体级结构；尺寸预测与形状补全联合训练以保证度量一致。任务网络仅在带位姿标注的合成 SOPE 数据上训练、骨干 RADIO 冻结，在 SOPE 与 ROPE 上达到 SOTA，纯位姿推理达 28 FPS。
items.highlight_zh: 单次前向28FPS完成类别级位姿、尺寸与形状联合预测
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：让机器人抓取没见过的物体时，需要知道它的三维朝向和位置（位姿），而且不能依赖每个物体的专属 CAD 模型。类别级位姿估计就是干这个的，但类内形状差异大、物体有对称性、还常被遮挡，导致结果歧义大。现有方法两难：靠中间结构（如 NOCS 类表示）一步步推，误差会层层累积；用扩散模型则推理慢、还要从一堆候选里挑。
2. 方法：F2G-Pose 走“一步到位”路线，单次前向同时输出位姿、真实尺度尺寸和相机坐标系下的完整形状。技术要点是“特征提升”：把强大的视觉基础模型（冻结的 RADIO）提取的稠密二维特征，提升到部分点云上；用 DGCNN 做词元化以捕捉局部几何；再用混合专家（MoE）Transformer 融合物体级结构。尺寸预测与形状补全联合训练，靠稠密几何监督保证尺度一致。任务网络只在带标注的合成数据 SOPE 上训练。
3. 结果：在 SOPE 与 ROPE 基准上达到最先进精度，仅位姿推理时达 28 FPS，满足实时需求；在 HouseCat6D 上相机系几何表现强，在 HANDAL 上展现对真实物体的迁移；附加的延迟、鲁棒性、形状补全与候选行为分析佐证了效率与可靠性，真机操作实验显示部署潜力。
4. 意义：证明不靠扩散、不靠多阶段流水线，也能又快又准地做类别级位姿估计，对实时机器人操作与抓取尤其实用；仅用合成数据训练而能迁移到真实物体，也降低了数据成本。
items.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, including the complete technical appendix

items.title_en: RESPLE2: Inertial-Informed Recursive Non-Uniform Spline Estimation for Multi-Sensor Odometry with Global Refinement
items.title_zh: RESPLE2：面向带全局精化的多传感器里程计的惯性信息递归非均匀样条估计
items.abstract_en: We present RESPLE2, a recursive multi-sensor state estimation framework using non-uniform B-splines for 6-DoF motion representation. By exploiting the knot-clamping boundary property, we propose a theoretically grounded mechanism for exact control-point prediction directly informed by inertial kinematics along the trajectory, with knot placement adapted to motion and measurement availability. Within an iterated extended Kalman filter, we perform this prediction using a subset of inertial measurements. A subsequent reset step preserves trajectory consistency as the knots extend. The update step further incorporates heterogeneous sensor measurements at their native timestamps through continuous-time observation models, supporting flexible combinations of LiDARs, cameras, inertial measurement units, and leg kinematics. We further develop a lightweight global optimization module that directly refines non-uniform B-spline control points by incorporating loop-closure constraints derived from LiDAR-visual cues. We conduct extensive evaluations on public and experimental datasets across handheld, tracked, legged, and hybrid aerial-legged platforms, covering highly dynamic maneuvers with extreme accelerations. Compared with state-of-the-art multi-sensor odometry systems, RESPLE2 achieves competitive or superior estimation accuracy and robustness in the corresponding sensor configurations, particularly under aggressive motion, while maintaining real-time operation. We publicly release our code and experimental datasets at https://github.com/ASIG-X/RESPLE2.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出RESPLE2，一种使用非均匀B样条进行6自由度运动表示的递归多传感器状态估计框架。通过利用节点夹持边界性质，我们提出一种有理论依据的机制，直接由沿轨迹的惯性运动学信息进行精确控制点预测，并使节点放置适应运动和测量可用性。在迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波中，我们使用惯性测量子集执行该预测。随后的重置步骤在节点扩展时保持轨迹一致性。更新步骤通过连续时间观测模型进一步在原生时间戳融合异构传感器测量，支持LiDAR、相机、惯性测量单元和腿部运动学的灵活组合。我们进一步开发一个轻量级全局优化模块，通过纳入由LiDAR-视觉线索导出的回环约束，直接细化非均匀B样条控制点。我们在手持、履带式、腿式以及混合空中-腿式平台上的公开和实验数据集进行了广泛评估，涵盖具有极端加速度的高动态机动。与最先进的多传感器里程计系统相比，RESPLE2在相应传感器配置下实现具有竞争力或更优的估计精度和鲁棒性，特别是在剧烈运动下，同时保持实时运行。我们在https://github.com/ASIG-X/RESPLE2公开代码和实验数据集。
items.comment: 18 pages

items.title_en: Real-Time Dynamics-Based Torque-Sampling MPPI for Compliant and Force Aware Manipulation
items.title_zh: 基于实时动力学的扭矩采样MPPI用于柔顺与力感知操作
items.abstract_en: This study proposes a novel Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI)-based task-space control framework. The proposed framework explicitly solves rigid-body dynamics within a real-time MPC formulation and enforces safety constraints, enabling accurate motion and force control that yields compliant behaviors for safe and effective physical interaction of robotic manipulators in unstructured environments. By leveraging MPPI, the proposed framework efficiently handles nonlinear dynamics that are difficult to solve with conventional MPC approaches in real-time. Furthermore, we develop a torque-sampling-based control architecture that enables efficient exploitation of GPU-based parallelization, resulting in effective compliant and force-aware behaviors. As a result, the proposed framework achieves a solver update rate of over 166 Hz with a 0.18 s prediction horizon, and its performance is validated through real-world experiments on a 7-DoF manipulator.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究提出一种新颖的基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）的任务空间控制框架。所提框架在实时MPC公式中显式求解刚体动力学并施加安全约束，实现精确的运动和力控制，从而产生柔顺行为，使机械臂在非结构化环境中安全有效地进行物理交互。通过利用MPPI，所提框架高效处理传统MPC方法难以实时求解的非线性动力学。此外，我们开发一种基于力矩采样的控制架构，能够高效利用GPU并行化，从而产生有效的柔顺和力感知行为。结果，所提框架在0.18 s预测时域下实现超过166 Hz的求解器更新率，并通过在7自由度机械臂上的真实世界实验验证其性能。
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

items.title_en: Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination
items.title_zh: 面向多机器人协调的分散树协议
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. Existing methods that approach joint optimality remain largely centralized, offline, and confined to collision-free motion planning, while decentralized, real-time counterparts target safe navigation without pursuing the joint optimum. This paper develops a decentralized, real-time planner that approaches the joint optimum as an anytime process. We extend a recent single-robot framework that searches dispersive trees of forward-propagated commands for differentially flat systems to coordinate a multi-robot team near-optimally. We first show that the inter-robot coupling can be effectively replaced by some local constraints, under which locally grown dispersive trees contain a near-optimal agreement. It is this structure that the robots pursue by decentralized column generation, negotiating rents on the shared space that guide the search of each robot's tree. The negotiation settles on an agreement whose near-optimality is certified at quiescence. Our protocol, WarpWeaver, implements this negotiation as an asynchronous real-time loop over a receding horizon, and demonstrates effective closure to quiesced agreements even when real-time deadlines cut the negotiation short. In simulation, WarpWeaver reduces total travel time by up to 22% against centralized offline planners on the Dynobench suite and by up to 37% against a decentralized real-time baseline, and nearly doubles the success rate of a task-specific planner on graph connectivity. Hardware experiments on six robots planning onboard demonstrate real-world implementability.
items.abstract_zh: 非线性系统的多机器人协调自然可表述为受机器人组约束的联合空间最优控制。现有接近联合最优性的方法在很大程度上仍是集中式、离线的，并局限于无碰撞运动规划，而分散式实时对应方法则以安全导航为目标，不追求联合最优。本文开发一种分散式实时规划器，以任意时间过程逼近联合最优。我们将近期一个单机器人框架——针对微分平坦系统搜索前向传播指令的离散树——扩展到近最优地协调多机器人团队。我们首先表明，机器人间耦合可被一些局部约束有效替代，在此约束下局部生长的离散树包含一个近最优一致解。正是这一结构，机器人通过分散式列生成来追求，就共享空间上的租金进行协商，以引导每个机器人树的搜索。协商最终达成一个一致解，其近最优性在静息时得到认证。我们的协议 WarpWeaver 将该协商实现为滚动时域上的异步实时循环，并证明即使实时截止时间缩短协商，也能有效收敛到静息一致解。在仿真中，WarpWeaver 在 Dynobench 套件上相比集中式离线规划器将总旅行时间最多减少 22%，相比分散式实时基线最多减少 37%，并在图连通性上将特定任务规划器的成功率几乎翻倍。在六台机器人上进行板载规划的硬件实验证明了真实世界可实施性。
items.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics

items.title_en: ChainSplat: A Physics-Inspired Screw-Theoretic Model for Learning Deformable Linear Object Dynamics from Multi-View RGB Videos
items.title_zh: ChainSplat：一种物理启发的螺旋理论模型，用于从多视角RGB视频学习可变形线性物体动力学
items.abstract_en: Identifying the underlying dynamics and 3D geometry of deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as cables, ropes, and hoses, is essential for accurate robotic manipulation, but remains challenging due to their high-dimensional configuration spaces and diverse behaviors arising from varying material properties. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines and auxiliary depth inputs, which are prone to errors under dynamic interactions, while their high-dimensional state representations make model-based control computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce ChainSplat, a physics-inspired framework that jointly learns the 3D geometry, appearance, kinematics, and dynamics of DLOs solely from multi-view RGB videos. ChainSplat represents a DLO as an open-chain structure of rigid links connected by revolute joints, yielding an analytic, screw-theoretic model with a compact state representation parameterized by joint configurations. By integrating this formulation with Gaussian splatting, ChainSplat jointly recovers DLO dynamics, kinematics-aware 3D geometry, and appearance, while enabling high-fidelity RGB rendering from arbitrary states. Through real-world experiments, we demonstrate that ChainSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance in dynamics predictions, 3D geometry reconstruction, and RGB rendering across dynamic interactions. ChainSplat further enables real-time state and force estimation, as well as accurate model-based trajectory optimization, highlighting its practical utility for real-world robotic manipulation of DLOs. Accompanying source code and video are available at: https://chainsplat.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 识别可变形线性物体（DLO）如线缆、绳索和软管的潜在动力学与3D几何对于准确的机器人操作至关重要，但由于其高维构型空间以及由不同材料属性产生的多样行为，仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖多阶段流程和辅助深度输入，在动态交互下容易产生误差，而其高维状态表示使基于模型的控制计算代价高昂。在本文中，我们提出ChainSplat，一种受物理启发的框架，仅从多视角RGB视频联合学习DLO的3D几何、外观、运动学和动力学。ChainSplat将DLO表示为通过旋转关节连接的刚性连杆开链结构，产生一种解析的、螺旋理论模型，其状态表示由关节构型参数化且紧凑。通过将该公式与高斯泼溅相结合，ChainSplat联合恢复DLO动力学、运动学感知的3D几何和外观，同时能够从任意状态进行高保真RGB渲染。通过真实世界实验，我们证明ChainSplat在动态交互中的动力学预测、3D几何重建和RGB渲染方面达到最先进性能。ChainSplat进一步实现实时状态和力估计，以及准确的基于模型的轨迹优化，突显其在实际机器人操作DLO中的实用性。源代码和视频见：https://chainsplat.github.io。
items.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures
